title: Remote Cold Caller / Appointment Setter
description:
We are a growing lead-generation and digital marketing company looking for a confident, professional Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to join our team.



You will contact businesses across North America, speak with receptionists and other gatekeepers, identify the person responsible for marketing or business growth, and help schedule qualified introductory meetings for our sales team.



This is not a high-pressure closing role. Your job is to start professional conversations, gather accurate information, identify potential interest and book meetings with the appropriate decision-maker.



## Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to businesses using prospect lists we provide

* Professionally communicate with receptionists, office administrators and business owners

* Identify the correct marketing or business-growth decision-maker

* Collect and verify names, job titles,
 addresses and direct contact information

* Briefly explain why we are calling and determine whether there may be a relevant need

* Send approved follow-up
s when appropriate

* Schedule qualified meetings for our sales team

* Record detailed and accurate notes in our CRM

* Follow call scripts while sounding natural and conversational

* Complete follow-up calls according to an established schedule

* Respect all do-not-call requests and company outreach policies

* Provide regular reporting on calls, conversations and appointments



## Who We’re Looking For



* Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, telemarketing or outbound sales experience

* Clear, professional spoken English that is easily understood by North American prospects

* Comfortable calling businesses and speaking with receptionists and decision-makers

* Friendly, confident and persistent without being aggressive

* Able to handle rejection and continue working with a positive, professional attitude

* Strong listening skills and the ability to adapt a conversation naturally

* Organized and consistent when recording notes and scheduling follow-ups

* Comfortable using a CRM, calling software,
 and online calendars

* Reliable computer, headset and high-speed internet connection

* Available during North American business hours



Experience calling medical clinics, professional offices or other service businesses is helpful, but not required. We value strong communication skills and reliability more than experience in one specific industry.



## How Success Will Be Measured



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Number of completed calls

* Meaningful business conversations

* Decision-makers correctly identified

* Accurate contact information collected

* Qualified appointments booked

* Appointment attendance rate

* Quality of CRM notes and follow-up

* Professionalism and consistency



Call volume matters, but we care more about productive conversations and qualified appointments than simply maximizing the number of dials.



## Compensation



* Competitive hourly compensation based on experience

* Performance bonuses for qualified appointments and successful results

* Initial paid trial period

* Opportunity for ongoing, long-term work

* Additional responsibilities and advancement opportunities for strong performers



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. A brief summary of your cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

2. The types of businesses or industries you have called

3. Your typical daily call volume and appointment results

4. Your availability in North American time zones

5. Your expected hourly rate

6. A 60–90 second video introduction so we can evaluate your spoken communication



In your recording, please introduce yourself and explain how you would respond if a receptionist said:



“We’re not interested. You can send something to our general
.”



Applications without a video introduction may not be considered.

title: EE/ECE/ME Grad? Korea's Global Trade Team Needs Your Engineering Brain
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or
 



[Closing Message]

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: CREATIVE Strategist - Part-time
description:
We're looking for a Creative Strategist to join our growing team and help develop high-converting creative concepts for paid social advertising.



This role is ideal for someone who understands what makes Meta ads perform and enjoys turning product insights into compelling ad angles, hooks, and creative briefs. You don't need to edit videos or design graphics yourself—your primary responsibility is developing the ideas that our creative team will bring to life.



What You'll Do



* Research products, competitors, and target audiences

* Develop creative angles and messaging for paid social campaigns

* Write compelling hooks, ad concepts, and creative briefs

* Generate fresh ideas for video and static ads

* Analyze winning ads and identify patterns that can be applied to new campaigns

* Collaborate with the creative tea
mbers to test and improve ad performance

* Continuously brainstorm new concepts to support scaling efforts



We're Looking For Someone Who



* Has experience with Meta 
 & Instagram) advertising

* Understands direct response marketing and consumer psychology

* Can develop creative concepts based on customer pain points and desires

* Is highly organized and able to manage multiple projects

* Has strong written English communication skills

* Takes initiative and enjoys problem-solving

* Is reliable, proactive, and easy to work with



Bonus If You Have Experience With



* DTC or eCommerce brands

* Creative strategy for paid social

* Copywriting for ads

* Reading Meta Ads performance metrics

* TikTok or other paid social platforms



Position Details

* Part-time

* Remote

* Flexible schedule (some overlap with the team may be requested)

* Opportunity for long-term growth



To Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and link to your most updated CV.

2. Your experience with Meta ads or creative strategy.

3. Examples of creative briefs, ad concepts, or campaigns you've worked on (if available).

4. Your favorite DTC brand and why you think their advertising works well.

5. The word ANGLE at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the entire job post.



We're looking for someone who doesn't just generate ideas, but understands *why* certain creatives work and can consistently produce concepts that help drive performance. Apply now!

title: Graphic Designer
description:
I'm a content creator and founder looking for a genuinely excellent Graphic Designer to help me turn written content into carousels, infographics, and event graphics. Your primary focus will be Instagram and LinkedIn carousels for my personal brand, plus a recurring set of event promotion assets for the live events I run in Montreal.



This role starts with a short paid trial task so we can both make sure it's a good fit before committing. From there, it moves into a part-time arrangement, with room to grow as my content and event volume increases. I'm not looking for a one-off freelancer --- I'm looking for someone to grow with me long-term. 



This role will also evolve over time. I'm not looking for someone who just executes a checklist --- I'm looking for someone experienced enough to help me build the most efficient design workflow possible and proactively suggest improvements. If you've worked with personal brands before and have opinions on what actually stops the scroll, I want to hear them.



I am willing to pay more money if your quality and experience are commensurate. 



==== A note on AI ====

I want human design work, and I'm paying for a human eye --- if your portfolio contains primarily AI-generated images or illustrations, I will pass immediately. 



If your portfolio contains AI-generated images or AI-generated illustrations, I'll pass immediately. If your application reads like it was written by ChatGPT, I'll pass immediately. I read a lot of these and it's obvious.



==== The Style I'm Going For ==== 



Here are three reference accounts that capture the vibe I want: 



Reference 1 (Carousel) --- 

Reference 2 (Carousel)  --- 

Reference 3 (Infographic) --- 

Reference 4 (Event graphics) --- 



==== Key Responsibilities ====

 

Content design:



Turn my written posts into 5-10 slide carousels (1080x1350, for both Instagram and LinkedIn)

Cut out photos of me cleanly and place them on flat colour backgrounds (hair edges matter)

Design explanatory graphics: frameworks, step diagrams, 2x2 matrices, before/after comparisons



Event design:



Design Luma event cover images (1:1 square, must stay legible at small preview sizes)

Build a repeatable event asset kit: cover image, speaker announcement graphics, Instagram story assets, LinkedIn announcement graphic, urgency/last-spots variant, post-event recap graphic

Lay out speaker headshots, partner logos, and event details cleanly under real constraints



System work:

Maintain and extend my brand template system so everything stays visually consistent

Adapt one piece of content across formats, recomposing rather than cropping

Prep and organize assets in a shared folder with clear naming

Proactively suggest layout improvements, format ideas, and design trends you're seeing work right now



==== Requirements====

Proven experience designing carousels, social graphics, and event promotion assets --- portfolio required

Strong typography instinct: type scale, hierarchy, spacing, letter-spacing. This is the main thing I'm hiring for.

The ability to make something legible and striking at thumbnail size, not just at full size

Advanced Canva (building and maintaining brand kits and templates, not just filling in stock layouts)

Photoshop or equivalent for background removal and clean cutouts

Excellent written English --- you'll be laying out my sentences and I don't want words breaking in the wrong places

Ability to hold one visual system across dozens of pieces without it drifting



Bonus: Figma or Illustrator, basic motion (simple animated versions of static slides), previous experience designing for live events or a solo creator



Salary: 8-12 USD/hr depending on experience, or a per-piece rate if you prefer --- tell me which works better for you.



The top of that range is real, but it's for someone with a genuinely strong portfolio and the judgment to go with it. Tell me what you think you're worth and show me why. I pay well for people who are good and I don't haggle over a dollar an hour.



==== How to Apply ====



Please send the following. Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.



(1) A link to your design portfolio --- carousels, social graphics, and event assets specifically. Show me work you personally designed, and tell me exactly which parts were yours.



(2) Look at this carousel: 

 Tell me three specific things that are wrong with it and how you'd fix each one. Be specific --- point at type sizes, margins, hierarchy, whatever you actually see. This is the part of the application I care most about.



(3) Tell me the first three questions you'd ask me before opening Canva if I sent you a 300-word post and asked for a 7-slide carousel.



Please make the subject line of your application "Slide Three: [Your Name]"



If you advance to the next stage, you will get a paid trial --- one carousel plus one infographic from copy and references I provide. Paid whether or not I hire you.

 or other video review platforms

The role: You'll be on the phone conducting screening calls with insurance agent candidates, asking the right questions, reading between the lines, and moving the right people forward. Some calls will go off-script. You'll need the judgment to know how to respond in the 
nt, when to be warm and empathetic, and when to keep things moving.



Who thrives here:

- Prior experience in recruiting, phone screening, or candidate sourcing preferred

- Fluent, natural English, not robotic or overly rehearsed

- Genuinely enjoys talking to people and it shows in your energy

- Reads a room (or a phone call) and adjusts on the fly

- Common sense to handle questions that fall outside the script

- Warm but professional, knows when empathy is needed and when to stay efficient

- Comfortable owning conversations, not just following a checklist



Why VAs stay with us:

- Weekly check-ins with your Account Manager, so you're never left guessing

- Ongoing access to trackers and training videos

- Performance feedback and retraining if you need it



Compensation:

- 20 hrs/week: $400/month, 1 client

- 30 hrs/week: $600/month, 1 client

- 40 hrs/week: $800/month, 1 full-time client or up to 2 part-time clients

- Paid bi-monthly via Wise

- US time zone hours (EST/CST)



Grow with us: Insurance eligibility at 6 months for Full-Time VAs, discretionary annual performance based increases, and a performance-based Christmas bonus.



We're looking for: Hungry, hardworking, humble, honest, smart candidates who take initiative without being asked twice. Recruiting or phone screening experience is a strong plus. Honesty and confidentiality are non-negotiable, since you'll be handling sensitive applicant data.



**How to Apply**



To apply, please submit both of the following:



- Updated Resume

- 1-Minute Intro Video



In your intro video, please tell us:

-A little about yourself

-Your background and work experience

-How many hours you're available to work each week

-Why you want to become a Virtual Assistant



Only applicants who submit both a resume and an intro video will be considered.



To show you've read the entire job post, please use this exact subject line when you apply:



Recruiting Specialist Application | Your Full Name



Applications with a different subject line may not be reviewed.

title: Client Activation Manager – $900 p/m + Bonuses (Up to $1,400/month)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

description:
About Us

YASSAS Group runs Melbourne's top-rated halal Greek restaurants — currently five venues (Southbank, Craigieburn, Docklands, Eastland, South Morang) with Mitcham opening soon. We serve authentic Greek food and drive bookings through OpenTable, direct web, and increasingly through paid Google and Meta ads.



We're growing fast and need a hands-on paid ads specialist to own our digital advertising end-to-end.



The Role

You'll be the person responsible for turning our monthly ad spend into restaurant bookings. Not vanity metrics. Not impressions. Not "brand awareness." Bookings.



You'll work remotely with full autonomy over campaign strategy, creative direction, testing, and reporting. Direct access to the owner. No layers, no politics — decisions get made and executed.



Key Responsibilities

Campaign management

Build, launch and optimise Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube) and Meta Ads 
, Instagram) across all venues

Manage monthly budget across venues, campaigns and audience segments

Continuous optimisation — bid adjustments, audience refinement, keyword management, negative keywords, exclusions

Set up and maintain conversion tracking, pixels, and attribution correctly (Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API)

Creative development

Ideate, brief and produce ad creatives (images, video, copy) from our brand assets

Test multiple creative angles — food photography, testimonials, offers, events, Greek family occasions

Adapt creatives per venue, audience segment and campaign objective

Work within brand guidelines (fonts, colours, tone of voice)

Testing & optimisation

Structured A/B testing on creatives, audiences, offers, and landing pages

Weekly performance reviews and adjustments

Kill underperforming campaigns fast; scale winners

Test new ad formats, placements and audience types as platforms evolve

Analysis & reporting

Weekly report to the owner: spend, cost per booking, revenue attribution, ROAS per venue

Monthly deep-dive: what worked, what didn't, next month's plan

Attribute conversions correctly across GA4, Meta Ads Manager, and OpenTable bookings

Who You Are

Must have

Minimum 2 years hands-on experience running Google Ads and Meta Ads (please don't apply if you're a "strategy person only" — this is an execution role)

Proven track record of driving bookings, leads or sales — not just impressions. Bring the numbers.

Fluent English (written and spoken) — daily communication is in English

Ability to work independently and manage your own schedule

Strong analytical mindset — comfortable with ROAS, CPA, attribution, funnels

Basic-to-intermediate design skills (Canva, Photoshop or similar)

Nice to have

Prior experience with hospitality, restaurants, or booking-driven businesses

Video editing (CapCut, Premiere, or similar)

Experience with OpenTable, Square, or restaurant booking platforms

Familiarity with landing page tools (Unbounce, Instapage, WordPress)

Understanding of Meta dynamic ads / catalogue setup

Basic SEO understanding (as a bonus, not core)

Tools You'll Use

Google Ads Manager · Meta Business Suite · Google Analytics 4 · Google Tag Manager · Canva · OpenTable (reporting) · Slack / WhatsApp for daily comms



What We Offer

Meaningful ownership over real ad spend and real results

Direct access to the owner — decisions made fast

Long-term engagement — we don't want project workers, we want a partner

Rate discussed with successful candidates based on experience and hours

How Your Success Will Be Measured

One primary KPI: cost per booking, delivered.



Everything else — impressions, clicks, CTR, engagement, followers — is a leading indicator. What we care about is:



How many bookings did your ads drive last week?

What did each booking cost us?

Is that cost trending down as we optimise?

Monthly review, transparent numbers, no hiding behind vanity metrics.



How to Apply

Send us:



Your CV

Portfolio / case studies — campaigns you've run with the actual numbers (spend, results, cost per conversion). Screenshots welcome; blur out client names if under NDA.

A one-paragraph description of your most successful campaign to date and specifically WHY it worked

Your rate (hourly or monthly retainer) and hours per week you can commit

A note on your timezone — we need overlap with Melbourne (AEST/AEDT) hours for daily comms

Send to: 
] with subject line: "YASSAS Ads VA — [Your Name]"



Applications close: 20.8.2026



We respond to every serious application. Shortlisted candidates will do a paid trial project (real campaign, small budget) before being offered ongoing engagement.

title: UGC & INFLUENCER COORDINATOR

**Reports To:** Creative Strategist

**Salary:** TBD



## ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for a **UGC & Influencer Coordinator** to help manage our UGC creators and influencer projects for a growing ecommerce apparel brand.



Your main job is to make sure creator projects are organized, content is submitted correctly and on time, and all files and trackers are updated.



You will also help research ads, content ideas, hooks, and competitors for our Creative Strategist.



This role is a good fit for someone who is organized, responsible, good at following up, and comfortable communicating with creators.

title: Online Business Manager / Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced, highly proactive Online Business Manager (OBM) / Operations Manager to become the operational backbone of a fast-moving, founder-led personal brand and online education company.



This is not a VA or executive assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can take a vision, turn it into an executable plan, assign ownership, manage deadlines, follow up with the team, identify risks, and make sure projects actually cross the finish line — without the founder having to remember or manage every detail.



Our founder is highly creative, moves quickly, and generates a lot of ideas and opportunities. Your job is not simply to help her keep track of everything.



Your job is to build and manage an operating system so she doesn't have to.



What You'll Own



Project & Launch Management



Turn ideas, launches and initiatives into clear project plans, timelines and deliverables.

Assign tasks, owners and deadlines.

Proactively follow up with tea
mbers and contractors.

Identify bottlenecks before they become emergencies.

Manage multiple concurrent projects without losing sight of priorities.

Own final QA and ensure projects are actually complete before launch.

Run weekly team/operations meetings and keep them focused and productive.



Team Accountability



Know who owns what, what is on schedule, what is delayed and why.

Hold tea
mbers accountable without requiring the founder to intervene.

Follow up on missed deadlines and escalate appropriately.

Create clarity when ownership is ambiguous.

Help identify capacity issues and operational gaps before they become expensive.



Systems & Process



Build and improve SOPs, workflows, templates and recurring processes.

Move information out of the founder's head and into systems the team can use.

Identify repetitive work that should be delegated, templated or automated.

Maintain a reliable project-management system that the entire team actually uses.

Continuously look for ways to make the company simpler, faster and less founder-dependent.



Founder Support & Decision-Making



Protect the founder from unnecessary operational noise.

Determine what genuinely requires founder input versus what can be solved independently.

Push back when a new idea or priority threatens existing commitments.

Be comfortable saying: "Yes, we can do that — and here's what would need to move."

Bring problems with recommended solutions rather than simply escalating problems.

What We're Looking For



You are someone who gets genuine satisfaction from making a complicated business run beautifully.



You're not waiting for someone to tell you what to do next.



You naturally notice:



"Nobody owns this."



"We're going to miss this deadline."



"Why are we doing this manually?"



"This process shouldn't depend on the founder remembering it."



…and then you do something about it.



You are calm under pressure, exceptionally organized and comfortable working with highly creative people who may move faster than the systems around them.



You can zoom out and understand the priorities of the business, then zoom all the way in and notice that a link hasn't been tested before a launch.



Ideal Experience



We're especially interested in candidates with:



5+ years of experience in online business management, operations, project management, integrator, or similar roles.

Experience supporting a founder-led online business, personal brand, coaching/education company, agency, or digital-product business.

Demonstrated experience managing multiple tea
mbers and contractors.

Strong project-management experience across launches and ongoing operations.

Experience building SOPs and operational systems from scratch.

Strong understanding of automation and AI tools.

Experience with tools such as Airtable, ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Notion, Zapier or similar.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong judgment and ability to operate independently.

Comfort working with a U.S.-based team and customers.



Experience in the creator economy, coaching industry, premium/luxury brands, media, entertainment or personal-brand businesses is a plus.



This Role Is Probably NOT for You If...

You need detailed instructions before taking action.

Your primary experience is task-based virtual assistance.

You're excellent at maintaining systems but haven't built or improved them.

You avoid difficult conversations or struggle to hold people accountable.

You automatically escalate every decision to the founder.

You prefer working on one project at a time.

You consider a task complete because your portion is finished, even if the overall outcome isn't.

title: Power BI Data & Inventory Analytics Specialist
description:
We are an established, fast-growing multi-channel e-commerce brand managing a catalog of approximately 450 active products. We partner with large-scale distributors and manage data pipelines across several retail platforms and independent web storefronts. Our business model relies on operational efficiency, data precision, and real-time capital allocation.



Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled Data Analytics & Inventory Specialist to build, optimize, and maintain an automated data pipeline using Power BI and the Microsoft Ecosystem.

Your primary mission is to consolidate data from multiple distinct sources—including daily/weekly distributor spreadsheets, multi-channel platform sales data, and advertising metrics—into a unified, clean, and highly automated decision system that guides our replenishment and tracking.



Key Responsibilities



   1. Multi-Channel Profitability Dashboards

   * Build a unified data model in Power BI aggregating data from various third-party platform exports, independent storefront datasets, and ad platform reports.

      * Standardize and map product variations across disparate channels into a single master product table to handle naming and SKU discrepancies.

      * Write DAX measures to calculate true net margins per item by accurately separating channel-specific overhead and marketing expenses.

   2. Automated Supplier Inventory Matching

   * Utilize tools like Power Automate to streamline data extraction from recurring
 data dumps, auto-saving files to OneDrive or SharePoint.

      * Build automated "Buy Alert" modules that cross-reference incoming vendor stock levels against current internal inventory deficiencies to flag purchasing opportunities.

   3. Predictive Replenishment Forecasting

   * Structure robust data-cleaning steps in Power Query to normalize varying spreadsheet layouts and messy source files without breaking the primary dashboards.

      * Develop short-term and long-term moving velocity metrics to project exact depletion timelines and automate reorder point triggers.

   4. Capital Allocation & Budget Tools

   * Design interactive parameters (such as What-If sliders) to filter procurement metrics against fixed capital limits.

      * Program ranking models that dynamically prioritize item lists based on velocity, margin performance, and advertising efficiency.

   



 Required Technical Qualifications



* Strong proficiency in Power BI Desktop & Power BI Service (DAX data modeling and dashboard layout design).

* Proficiency with Power Query for advanced data cleansing, row filtering, cell normalization, and structural formatting.

* Familiarity or experience with workflow automation tools (such as Power Automate) for automated file management and ingestion.

* Extreme Attention to Detail: Our inventory health depends entirely on exact metrics. Missing data, uncleaned cells, or structural oversight in reporting cannot occur. Precision is always prioritized over speed.

* Experience or background in the e-commerce industry or multi-channel retail logistics is a major plus (knowledge of the Amazon ecosystem is highly valued but not strictly necessary).





 Missing a qualification? Apply Anyway!

If you match most of the requirements but are missing a specific tool or niche skill on this list, please do not let that stop you from applying! We value transparency, problem-solving skills, and a strong work ethic just as much as past experience.

If you are missing a specific tool (for example, you are a Power BI expert but have never used Power Automate for
 workflows):



* Be upfront with us in your application. Tell us exactly which qualification you are missing.

* Let us know your learning plan. If you are willing and able to research, upskill, and fill in that specific knowledge gap over your first few weeks on the job, we are more than happy to give you the time and flexibility to do so.

title: UGC Project Management Associate
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW:

Do you get a quiet thrill from a spreadsheet that actually matches reality?



Does it bother you — in a productive way — when a creator hasn't been followed up with, a deadline is about to slip, or a package hasn't shipped?



Are you the person who builds the tracking system before anyone asks?



Freebird® is a 9-figure DTC brand serving over 2 million customers and redefining shaving for the modern consumer. We grow through content, and the ads our creators film are the biggest engine behind that growth.



Here's our actual problem. We send 90 to 120 creator briefs a month. About 37% of them come back on time. The rest arrive late, or need chasing, or quietly die somewhere in the middle — and every one of those started as a strategist's work that produced nothing.



We're not going to fix that with better briefs. We're going to fix it with someone who follows up.



Our Creative Sourcing & Production team is four people, and right now all four do a little of everything: finding creators, signing them, matching them to briefs, and chasing every loose end in between. The chasing is eating the work that actually grows the program.



That's the job. We're hiring a UGC Project Management Associate to catch everything that falls through the gaps — so the rest of the team can do what only they can do, and so more of those 90 to 120 briefs turn into finished ads.



This is not a creator role. You won't be on camera and you won't be writing scripts. This is an execution role, and you'll thrive here if you think in checklists, love a closed loop, and treat "I'll follow up" as a promise.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Creator Follow-Through — the bulk of the job! Track every active brief and deadline across our scripted UGC program. Send pre-due reminders before deadlines, check in the day after one slips, and send warm winback notes to creators who've gone quiet. Answer creator questions on timelines and logistics within one business day. Be the person who knows, at any 
nt, the real status of everything in flight.



Technical Support for Creators – Walk creators through submitting raw footage the right way. Catch and fix file naming problems before they reach post-production. Confirm finals and raw have both arrived before a submission counts as complete. Troubleshoot the small technical friction that quietly costs everyone days.



The Revision Loop – Our UGC program works from scripts, and what comes back doesn't always match what we asked for. Check every delivery against the approved script and flag what's missing or off-script. Relay revision requests clearly and warmly, with a specific deadline attached. Track every round to closed — nothing sits in limbo, and no round gets opened twice for the same issue.



Product, Props & Setup – Send product and props to creators, track shipments, and confirm delivery before their filming window opens. Confirm every new creator's whitelisting connection actually went through. Flag delays, address problems, and inventory gaps before they touch a creator's timeline.



Record Hygiene – If the Airtable says it, it's true. That standard starts with you. Keep statuses, dates, whitelisting access, and submission counts current within the same working session — not "later today". When a brief dies, record why. Right now most of our cancelled briefs have no reason attached, so we can't tell a bad match from a bad rate from a creator who ghosted. You'll change that. Open the tasks that hand finished footage to our post-production team, with everything they need attached.



Creator Club Support – We're launching a second program this fall (the Freebird Creator Club) where creators pitch their own ideas and edit their own work. Kenneth and our Creative Director run it. You'll handle its logistics: product, props, whitelisting, records. It's deliberately a lighter program to run and will be a small part of your week.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO

You don't write or send briefs. Kenneth does. You're copied, and you follow up.

You don't d
 which creator films which brief. 

You don't negotiate rates or terms. 

You don't give creative feedback. 



On UGC you check delivery against the script and flag what's objectively missing — but whether a performance works is the brief owner's call. On the Creator Club, creators self-edit and we never request revisions at all. Knowing which program you're in before you act is part of the job. You don't discuss creator rates. With anyone. You'll see what everyone is paid; it stays confidential, permanently.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Month 1: you know every active brief, every creator, and every deadline. The tracker is yours.

Month 3: Miguel spends zero hours chasing creators after a brief goes out. Ally isn't following up on paperwork. Kenneth stops asking "where are we on this?" because he can already see it.

Month 6: On-time delivery above 50%, from 37% today. Creators are difficult to pin down and always will be — we're not asking for perfection, we're asking for a real, sustained move.



Every pre-due reminder sent and every day-after follow-up inside 24 hours

Every creator message answered within one business day

Every revision round tracked to closed

Zero missed product or prop shipments

Every cancelled brief carries a reason, so we can finally see the pattern

An Airtable that never disagrees with reality



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Someone whose organizational instincts are almost involuntary — the kind of person who builds a tracking system before they're asked to. Relentlessly organized, and you genuinely enjoy following up. Friendly persistence is your professional superpower, not a chore. Written English that is warm, clear, and fast. Most of this role is short messages that keep people moving. You've run a deadline or approval loop with people who don't report to you — freelancers, contributors, vendors, creators. You know how to make someone want to hit your deadline. Comfortable with Asana, Airtable, Google Drive, and Sheets — or a demonstrated ability to learn operational tools quickly. Detail-oriented enough that a mismatched status in a tracker genuinely bothers you. Discreet – You'll see what every creator is paid. Calm under pressure and clear when things go sideways.



BONUS POINTS

Experience in influencer marketing, creator management, UGC production, or content operations. Background in project coordination or production coordination. Familiarity with Air for asset management. You've worked at a DTC brand or a fast-moving startup.



WHY FREEBIRD®

No politics, just execution. Join a fast-moving, high-ownership, results-driven culture. Make your mark by helping scale a 9-figure DTC brand on the verge of global breakout. Kind, people-focused team that communicates openly, collaborates well, and supports one another. We embrace growth and change, never settle, and continuously improve. We move fast, keep things simple, and innovate without fear. Remote-first and flexible. Work from anywhere with autonomy and trust. Unlimited PTO. Recharge when you need to, without counting days.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
I'm a content creator and founder looking for a genuinely excellent Graphic Designer to help me turn written content into carousels, infographics, and event graphics. Your primary focus will be Instagram and LinkedIn carousels for my personal brand, plus a recurring set of event promotion assets for the live events I run in Montreal.



This role starts with a short paid trial task so we can both make sure it's a good fit before committing. From there, it moves into a part-time arrangement, with room to grow as my content and event volume increases. I'm not looking for a one-off freelancer --- I'm looking for someone to grow with me long-term. 



This role will also evolve over time. I'm not looking for someone who just executes a checklist --- I'm looking for someone experienced enough to help me build the most efficient design workflow possible and proactively suggest improvements. If you've worked with personal brands before and have opinions on what actually stops the scroll, I want to hear them.



I am willing to pay more money if your quality and experience are commensurate. 



==== A note on AI ====

I want human design work, and I'm paying for a human eye --- if your portfolio contains primarily AI-generated images or illustrations, I will pass immediately. 



If your portfolio contains AI-generated images or AI-generated illustrations, I'll pass immediately. If your application reads like it was written by ChatGPT, I'll pass immediately. I read a lot of these and it's obvious.



==== Key Responsibilities ====

 

Content design:



Turn my written posts into 5-10 slide carousels (1080x1350, for both Instagram and LinkedIn)

Cut out photos of me cleanly and place them on flat colour backgrounds (hair edges matter)

Design explanatory graphics: frameworks, step diagrams, 2x2 matrices, before/after comparisons



Event design:



Design Luma event cover images (1:1 square, must stay legible at small preview sizes)

Build a repeatable event asset kit: cover image, speaker announcement graphics, Instagram story assets, LinkedIn announcement graphic, urgency/last-spots variant, post-event recap graphic

Lay out speaker headshots, partner logos, and event details cleanly under real constraints



System work:

Maintain and extend my brand template system so everything stays visually consistent

Adapt one piece of content across formats, recomposing rather than cropping

Prep and organize assets in a shared folder with clear naming

Proactively suggest layout improvements, format ideas, and design trends you're seeing work right now



==== Requirements====

Proven experience designing carousels, social graphics, and event promotion assets --- portfolio required

Strong typography instinct: type scale, hierarchy, spacing, letter-spacing. This is the main thing I'm hiring for.

The ability to make something legible and striking at thumbnail size, not just at full size

Advanced Canva (building and maintaining brand kits and templates, not just filling in stock layouts)

Photoshop or equivalent for background removal and clean cutouts

Excellent written English --- you'll be laying out my sentences and I don't want words breaking in the wrong places

Ability to hold one visual system across dozens of pieces without it drifting



Bonus: Figma or Illustrator, basic motion (simple animated versions of static slides), previous experience designing for live events or a solo creator



Salary: 8-12 USD/hr depending on experience, or a per-piece rate if you prefer --- tell me which works better for you.



The top of that range is real, but it's for someone with a genuinely strong portfolio and the judgment to go with it. Tell me what you think you're worth and show me why. I pay well for people who are good and I don't haggle over a dollar an hour.



==== How to Apply ====



Please send the following. Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed.



(1) A link to your design portfolio --- carousels, social graphics, and event assets specifically. Show me work you personally designed, and tell me exactly which parts were yours.



(2) Tell me EXACTLY how your background is the right fit for this role (link me to any portfolio work that demonstrates you can do the kind of work I'm looking for (see jayhoovy and careerhannah on Instagram for the style I'm looking for)



(3) Tell me any relevant client work with coaches/founders with personal brands



Please make the subject line of your application "Slide Three: [Your Name]"



If you advance to the next stage, you will get a paid trial --- one carousel plus one infographic from copy and references I provide. Paid whether or not I hire you.

title: HIGH TICKET CLOSER — US Home Services (Night Shift, Base + 10% Commission)
description:
We book the calls. You close them. Every lead is pre-qualified and expecting your call.



We're a US marketing company that fills the calendars of roofing and HVAC contractors. Our outbound team books 20 to 30 qualified calls a week with business owners who have already agreed to hear the offer. Right now the founder is taking every one of those calls himself and he has run out of hours. That's the job.



You are not cold calling. You are not prospecting. You close warm, booked appointments with business owners who know why you're calling.



What you'll actually do

Take 4 to 6 booked calls a day with US roofing and HVAC owners. Run a 20-minute consultative call: qualify, diagnose, present, close. Collect payment on the call. Log everything properly so our build team delivers what you promised. Follow up the ones who don't close first time.



What you're selling

Booked appointments with homeowners who need work done, plus the system that keeps booking them — an AI receptionist answering their calls 24/7, a new website, 60-second lead response, Google Business Profile setup. $2,500 upfront, then $297/month. Real product, real delivery team.



You must have

2+ years closing on the phone, at least one year selling to US or Western clients. A track record with $1,000+ ticket sizes — this is not appointment setting. Excellent spoken English, neutral or light accent. The confidence to talk to a 50-year-old roofing company owner like a peer, not a call centre. Ability to work 9:00 PM – 6:00 AM Manila time — this is a night shift, and if that doesn't work for your life please don't apply. Fibre internet, quiet room, proper headset.



Pay

Base $600/month plus 10% of every dollar you collect, paid on collection. Realistic first 90 days $1,500–$2,500/month; a strong closer clears $3,000+ in our better months. Paid twice monthly, raise reviewed at 90 days.



Why this seat is good

The pipeline already exists — four full-time setters feed you, you'll never hunt. The founder closed these himself for months, so the script is proven rather than theoretical. Small team, direct access to the owner. The first closer here ends up leading the sales team.



HOW TO APPLY — read carefully. Applications without a voice recording will not be opened.



1.? ?Start your message with the word ROOFTOP.



2.? ?Send a 2-minute voice recording (Drive, Loom, Vocaroo) answering two things: the biggest deal you've closed on the phone and how you closed it — then pretend I'm a roofing owner who just said "I've tried lead companies before, they were a waste of money" and respond exactly as you would on a real call.



3.? ?Tell me your biggest ticket size, most calls handled in a day, and whether the 9 PM – 6 AM shift genuinely works long-term.



No CV needed first round. I care how you sound and how you handle the objection.

title: Digital Client Manager
description:
Position Description



Title:  Digital Client Manager

Location:  London, UK

Reporting to:  Senior Project Manager



Proactive and the Position Available



Proactive is a global, multimedia organisation providing breaking news, commentary and analysis on hundreds of listed companies and pre-IPO businesses across the globe, 24/7. And, uniquely, our renowned multi-media business is complemented by quality events management, smart investor relations delivery and a highly respected research offering. 

This role will sit within our entity Proactive Digital Solutions UK, which is a digital services agency providing modern, responsive, and polished corporate websites, micro-sites, investor relations tools and market data feeds to quoted companies across multiple markets.

With decades’ experience across digital development, investor relations, corporate communications, multimedia, and branding, we offer brighter thinking that’s at the forefront of technology.



Position Summary



As Proactive and Proactive Digital Solutions continue to grow we are looking for a mission-focused, client driven, and process-minded Client Support Manager to help manage and grow our company. 

This is a full-time role and you will be working as part of a talented and supportive team. You will be involved in managing day to day communications with our clients, providing front line support and assistance, assigning tasks to the development team, identifying potential upsell opportunities and in general, providing a friendly, dynamic, responsive and helpful face to our existing clients. 

You will be working with our project management team, our sales team and with our web design and web development team to help drive continuous improvement within the company. 



Principal Accountabilities / Responsibilities



Client Support:

- We use the SugarCRM ticketing system which supports our global web teams. The successful candidate for this role will need to play a key role in helping to manage and refine the Sugar ticketing system and be a contact point internally for any issues, training, and general support requests related to the system.

- Maintain, manage and monitor all client support requests that come in - via phone or
 - for updates, changes, questions on their website and/or our services etc.

- Ensure all support requests are responded to and actioned in a timely manner. 

- While most support requests will be assigned to the development team to complete, you will be required to monitor that these are being actioned as expected, provide clients with updates or additional information requests, as needed. 

- Maintain and monitor requests using Sugar Serve (the Group ticketing system) where support requests are logged and tracked. Our website clients purchase support hours against which site updates and changes are made, these need to not only be kept up to date, but when running low, a client will need to be contacted to request that additional hours are purchased.

- Be able to provide individual reports to clients who request to see a log of all site updates and changes over a given period. 

- Proactively contact clients ahead of financial announcements or other key dates in order to manage site updates in advance. 

- Note that while the role is full time and normal office hours, there will be times when a client request requires an early morning, evening or weekend activity. This is typically managed and agreed in advance but this role does require some flexibility around working hours.



Person Specification



The successful candidate will demonstrate the following core strengths:

- Native-like English speaker

- Excellent verbal and written skills 

- Ability to multi-task and prioritise in a deadline driven environment 

- Excellent task management and organizational skills

- Dynamic, self motivated and proactive, able to work quickly and accurately 

- Experienced working in an office environment, using PC or Mac, working with MS Office products etc.

- Demonstrable understanding of web design and web development projects

- Ability to work with web developers



Desirable skills 

- Experience of CRMs, ideally Sugar CRM 

- Experience of WordPress 

- Some understanding of the stock market, investor relations tools and investor communities would be beneficial

- Experience of Google Analytics and SEO



Work environment - What We Offer



In return we offer a competitive salary in a central location, a professional environment, flexible working hours and the opportunity to learn about the financial markets and the companies that operate within them.

You will work in an established but innovative organisation and get to be part of a fast-growing company which offers a challenge and a great opportunity to develop your skills.

You will also be able to expand your understanding of the financial markets and help us expand the services and products that we are able to offer. You will also be able to input into our own website and general company branding.



How to Apply



If you are organised, client-focused and want to play a key role in delivering digital support for a global organisation, we want to hear from you.

To apply, send your CV to: 

Include your contact details, availability and a brief overview of your relevant experience. Only successful candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior Accountant — NetSuite / Multi-Entity
description:
Senior Accountant with multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience in a multi-entity environment, joining an established accounting team at an energy industry company. Immediate-start contract, 2–3 months, extension possible. Remote, full-time, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific.





Summary

Senior Accountant — NetSuite, Multi-Entity Contract (2–3 months, extension possible) · Remote · Full-time, US Pacific hours · Immediate start



Bridged Financial Solutions is a fully remote US accounting, tax, and fractional CFO firm. We are staffing a Senior Accountant for a client in the energy industry that runs NetSuite across a multi-entity structure.



The client has an established accounting department of roughly eight onshore staff. This role is additional capacity alongside that team — you will be working within their existing close process, standards, and review structure rather than building or running your own.



This is a hands-on production seat. You will be in NetSuite every day.



Scope

The exact task mix is being finalized as we determine which work moves to this role. It will draw from across the close cycle rather than sitting in one corner of the system, so what matters is that you can be handed any core piece of NetSuite.



You should have working command of, at minimum:



General ledger — journal entries, recurring and memorized entries, accruals, prepaids, allocation schedules

Period close — Period Close Checklist, A/P and A/R sub-period locking versus GL close, post-close corrections

Accounts payable — vendor bills, bill credits, payment runs, vendor records

Accounts receivable — invoicing, customer payments, credit memos, aging and collections

Banking and reconciliation — bank feeds and statement imports, account reconciliation, deposits, undeposited funds

Multi-subsidiary and consolidation — subsidiary hierarchy, intercompany transactions, eliminations, consolidated reporting

Segmentation — subsidiary, class, department, location, and custom segments, and when each should be used

Fixed assets — asset records, depreciation schedules, disposals

Reporting — standard financials, report customization, and saved searches (criteria, results, and formula fields)

System fundamentals — roles and permissions, audit trail and system notes, record hierarchy



Beyond the mechanics, we expect you to reconcile what you touch, document your workpapers so they stand on their own, and raise misclassifications, duplicates, and control gaps when you find them rather than booking around them.



Requirements

Multiple years of hands-on NetSuite experience as a preparer — not a report consumer

Genuine multi-entity experience: multiple subsidiaries, intercompany activity, consolidated reporting

Strong month-end close and balance sheet reconciliation discipline

Advanced Excel at a workpaper-building level — pivots, lookups, clean tie-outs

Comfortable working in the Microsoft 365 environment — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint / OneDrive

Able to work effectively inside an established team: take direction, follow existing conventions, and communicate status without being chased

Written English strong enough to document your own work and escalate an issue clearly

Availability for the full US Pacific business day, Monday through Friday

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, a backup connection and power plan, and a private workspace



Nice to have

BS Accountancy; CPA or CPA candidate

Experience in energy, utilities, power generation, or another capital-intensive industry

Project or job costing experience

Prior experience supporting a US-based accounting department



Details

Independent contractor engaged directly by Bridged Financial Solutions

Full-time, approximately 40 hours per week, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time

Initial term of 2–3 months with an immediate start; extension possible

Compensation: competitive, depending on experience

You provide your own equipment; we provide all software access

NDA and background check required before any client data access





Three to five sentences on the largest multi-entity NetSuite environment you have worked in — number of subsidiaries, currencies, and what you personally owned in the close

Your expected hourly rate (USD) and earliest start date



Applications missing #2 will not be reviewed.



B. Screening questions

Questions

1) What NetSuite role did you hold (Accountant / Controller / Administrator / custom)? Could you post journal entries and close periods yourself?

Separates preparers from people who ran reports out of someone else's instance.

2) In the largest environment you worked in: how many subsidiaries, how many currencies, and was it NetSuite OneWorld?

The single highest-value filter. A meaningful share of applicants describe several separate QuickBooks files as "multi-entity."

3) Can you commit to 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific, Monday through Friday, for the next three months? What other engagements would you be working around?

Moonlighting on top of an existing full-time job is the most common failure mode on contract hires.

4) Which of the following have you personally worked in: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, fixed assets, intercompany/eliminations, saved searches?

Breadth check, since the scope isn't fixed. Gaps aren't automatically disqualifying — clustering in only one or two is.

5) Describe the accounting team you last worked in. How many people, and where did your work go for review?

This role slots into an eight-person department. You want someone used to a review chain, not a sole-charge operator.

6) What is your internet speed, and what is your backup for outages?

7) Expected hourly rate in USD?





Technical screen 

1. "Walk me through your month-end close in NetSuite, day one to sign-off."



2. "How does NetSuite handle intercompany? Take one transaction from origination through elimination." 



3. "What's the difference between closing a period and locking a period? What do you do when a correction is needed after close?"



4. "Describe a saved search you built and why a standard report wouldn't do it.



5. "Tell me about a balance sheet account that wouldn't reconcile. How did you find the break?" 



6. "How do you d
 whether something should be tracked by class, department, location, or a custom segment?" 



7. "You're new to a team that already has its own way of doing things, and you think one of their reconciliation schedules is wrong. What do you do?"

title: Personal Assistant to the CEO
description:
Personal Assistant to the CEO



Location: Remote / Flexible

Role Type: Full-Time



About the Role



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Personal Assistant to support our CEO, Olly Arch. In this role, you will serve as a trusted extension of the CEO, ensuring that day-to-day professional and personal operations run smoothly and efficiently.



The ideal candidate is someone who anticipates needs, communicates clearly and kindly, and operates with a "Design the Play" mentality—always coming prepared and aware of all moving pieces. You will manage communications, ensure critical business tasks and agreements are completed on time, and handle personal lifestyle support so the CEO can focus entirely on high-impact work.



North Star Principles



To succeed in this role, the assistant must align with five core principles. First, you must protect the CEO's time by filtering all inbound requests and prioritizing what is truly important. Second, calendar efficiency is paramount; you must be clear, committed, and always include context. Third, every correspondence should be answered clearly and kindly, showing appreciation for the response whether it is a 'yes' or a polite decline. Fourth, you must "Design the Play" by being preemptive and coming prepared for all moving pieces. Finally, prioritizing revenue is essential—tasks should be ordered based on what will generate the biggest outcome, as making or saving money is the ultimate priority.



Key Responsibilities



Communication Management



Managing the CEO's communications is a critical daily function. You will process the CEO's inbox twice daily, aiming for Inbox Zero by 10 AM EST and 5 PM EST. This involves filtering inbound requests, tagging
s into the appropriate categories (Personal, Sales & External, Internal, Hiring, Legal, Travel, Events, and Financial), and responding on the CEO's behalf using established templates. A strict one-day turnaround is expected for initial
 responses, resolutions, online orders, and payment notifications. You will also send end-of-day updates to keep the CEO informed of any unaddressed items.



Business Operations & Task Management



You will be responsible for ensuring that key business tasks are completed on time and nothing falls through the cracks. This includes tracking and following up on agreements, contracts, and legal documents to ensure they are signed and executed promptly. You will maintain a daily to-do list, manage action items fro
etings, and coordinate with internal tea
mbers and external contacts on the CEO's behalf. Staying informed about key business projects and deadlines is essential so you can proactively flag issues and keep the CEO updated.



Personal & Lifestyle Support



You will handle a range of personal tasks to ensure the CEO maintains a balanced and well-supported lifestyle.



Responsibility Area

Details & Preferences

Nutrition

Order daily lunch and dinner, selecting natural food options (e.g., Pura Vida, Just Salad) with simple ingredients (chicken, steak, broccoli, eggs) while avoiding seed and vegetable oils.

Household Management

Coordinate cleaners twice a week for apartment cleaning, laundry, and ironing, utilizing local services like the NOON app when the CEO is in Dubai.

Financial Monitoring

Handle company and personal purchases, manage gifting for clients, friends, and family, and monitor expenses and budgets related to the CEO's activities.









Requirements



The successful candidate will have proven experience as a Personal Assistant or Executive Assistant supporting C-level executives. Exceptional organizational and time-management skills are required, along with strong written and verbal communication abilities to draft professional correspondence and confidently respond on behalf of the CEO. You must be highly proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs) and comfortable managing sensitive documents, agreements, and financial information. Above all, you must be a proactive problem-solver who handles sensitive information with the utmost discretion and anticipates issues before they arise.



Compensation



This role offers a base salary of $800 USD per month, with on-target earnings (OTE) ranging from $1,000 to $1,200 USD per month inclusive of performance-based incentives.
