title: Video Production
description:
Run Our Automated YouTube Video Workflow (Long-Term)



We run a fast-growing YouTube channel management company. Our videos are largely generated by our own automation tool, we're looking for a reliable VA to operate that workflow from start to finish: input ? generate ? polish ? publish.



How the workflow works:



Input — You receive the topic and materials for each video and fill in the required info in our tool

Generate — The tool automatically creates the full video for you

Edit — You do a light final edit: the videos are slideshow-style (images placed in sequence), so this is quick and simple — no advanced editing skills needed. You check that everything flows well, fix anything that looks off, and make sure the output is clean

Publish — You upload the finished video to the right YouTube channel, add the title, description, and thumbnail, and schedule it according to our publishing calendar



You'll be running this workflow across multiple channels on a fixed weekly schedule.



What you'll be responsible for:



Producing and publishing videos end-to-end using our tool

Making sure every video meets our quality bar before it goes live

Publishing the right video to the right channel, on time, every time

Keeping our tracker updated so the team always knows the status of each video

Flagging issues early (tool errors, missing materials) instead of letting deadlines slip



What we're looking for:



Comfortable learning new software quickly, we'll train you on our tool with full documentation and examples

Basic video editing skills (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or similar). The editing is simple, but your eye for detail matters

Experience with YouTube Studio (uploading, scheduling, metadata) is a big plus

Extremely reliable, our channels run on a fixed publishing schedule and consistency is everything

Organized: you'll manage multiple channels at once without mixing things up

Daily communication in English via WhatsApp/Slack



What we offer:



A long-term role with growing volume — we onboard new channels every month, so your workload (and income) grows with us

Full training, templates, and step-by-step documentation, you're never guessing

A simple, repeatable workflow: once you know it, you can move fast

Flexible hours, as long as the publishing schedule is met





How to apply:

Send us:



A short intro about yourself and your experience with video editing and/or YouTube

1–2 examples of videos you've worked on (slideshow-style is a plus, not required)

Your rate (per video or per month)



Start your application with the word "FREQUENCY" so we know you've actually read this post. Applications without it will be ignored.

title: Tax Professional
description:
Tax Professional / Bookkeeper (CPA Preferred) — Personal Injury Law Firm



Crooks Law Firm | [Location / Remote] | [Full-Time / Part-Time] | 



About the Role



A growing personal injury practice, is looking for an experienced Tax Professional / Bookkeeper to own the firm's books, tax compliance, and financial reporting. This role keeps the financial engine of the firm running: day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll, trust accounting, tax preparation and planning, and clean monthly reports the owner can make decisions with.





What You'll Do

Maintain the firm's books end to end: chart of accounts, journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end close (QuickBooks or similar)



Track case costs and advances per matter so recoverable costs are captured at settlement



Prepare and file business and, as applicable, individual tax returns (federal and state); manage estimated tax payments and deadlines



Deliver monthly financial statements — P&L, balance sheet, cash flow — plus payroll and case-cost summaries

Support year-end tax planning: entity structure, deductions, retirement plan contributions, and quarterly strategy check-ins with the owner



3+ years of bookkeeping and tax preparation experience for small businesses

Proficiency with QuickBooks (Online or Desktop) and Excel/Google Sheets

Hands-on experience preparing and filing business tax returns (Schedule C, 1120-S, or 1065) and payroll filings (941, 940, W-2, 1099)

Strong understanding of GAAP basics, reconciliations, and month-end close

Impeccable attention to detail and absolute discretion with confidential financial information

Excellent written English and responsive communication

Strongly Preferred

CPA license or EA (Enrolled Agent) credential

Law firm accounting experience — trust/IOLTA management is a major plus

Experience with contingency-fee practices (settlement statements, cost recovery, fee splits, lien payoffs)



Experience supporting a solo/small firm owner with personal + business tax planning

Why Join Us

Own the whole finance function — no bureaucracy, direct line to the firm owner

Growing firm with a collaborative pre-litigation and operations team



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short cover note to 
 with the subject line "Tax Pro / Bookkeeper". In your note, tell us: (1) your credential (CPA, EA, or other) and years of small-business tax experience, (2) which accounting software you use daily, and (3) whether you have handled attorney trust/IOLTA accounts — and if so, where. Applicants who address all three will be reviewed first.

title: Amazon Account Manager | Client-Facing | PPC + Catalog Management
description:
Amazon Account Manager | Client-Facing | PPC + Catalog Management

Peak ROAS | Remote | Full-Time



ABOUT PEAK ROAS



Peak ROAS is a full-service Amazon growth agency helping established brands improve profitability and performance across the Amazon marketplace.



We manage more than advertising. Our team works across Amazon PPC, catalog management, listing optimization, promotions, inventory strategy, and overall marketplace growth.



We are a systems-driven company that uses proprietary software, automation, and AI to help our team work more efficiently and make better decisions.



We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Manager who combines strong hands-on Amazon expertise with excellent client communication.



THE ROLE



This is a client-facing and hands-on Amazon management position.



You will help manage the day-to-day performance of multiple Amazon accounts while serving as a primary point of contact for your assigned clients.



You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. business owners, executives, and eCommerce teams through video calls,
, and chat.



You will be expected to understand what is happening within each account, identify opportunities and problems, recommend actions, and clearly explain the strategy to the client.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes tasks behind the scenes. We want someone who can take ownership of an Amazon account and confidently communicate with the client about it.



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS



* 3+ years of hands-on Amazon account management experience

* Strong direct Amazon PPC management experience

* Experience managing multiple Amazon accounts simultaneously

* Strong knowledge of Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display

* Hands-on experience using Amazon Ads bulk files

* Strong Amazon catalog and listing management experience

* Experience with parent/child variations and category flat files

* Strong Google Sheets and/or Excel skills

* Experience working with advertising automation or rules-based systems

* Strong practical use of AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Comfortable leading professional client video calls in English

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail

* Able to work independently, solve problems, and take ownership of results



Amazon agency experience managing multiple client accounts is strongly preferred.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



CLIENT & ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT



* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned Peak ROAS clients

* Lead regular client video calls and performance discussions

* Explain performance, challenges, opportunities, strategy, and next steps clearly

* Respond professionally and promptly to client
s and messages

* Proactively communicate problems rather than waiting for clients to discover them

* Track client requests and ensure commitments are completed

* Manage expectations and build strong client relationships through competence and follow-through



AMAZON ADVERTISING | APPROXIMATELY 50%



Manage Amazon PPC across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display, including:



* Campaign structure and optimization

* Bids, targeting, search terms, and negative keywords

* Search-term harvesting and target promotion

* Budgets and placements

* Amazon Ads bulk files

* ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, CPC, CVR, and other performance metrics

* Advertising strategy based on inventory, promotions, ranking goals, and business objectives



You will also work within Peak ROAS proprietary campaign management tools and automations.



CATALOG & LISTING MANAGEMENT | APPROXIMATELY 40%



* Manage parent/child variation structures

* Work with Amazon category flat files

* Resolve suppressed, inactive, stranded, or incorrectly configured listings

* Work with Seller Support to resolve catalog issues

* Optimize titles, bullets, backend search terms, and listing attributes

* Identify conversion opportunities

* Coordinate listing copy and creative recommendations

* Troubleshoot catalog issues affecting advertising or sales



DEALS, PROMOTIONS & INVENTORY | APPROXIMATELY 10%



* Coordinate Amazon deals, coupons, and promotions

* Align promotions with advertising strategy

* Monitor inventory levels and days of supply

* Identify potential stockout risks

* Adjust advertising strategy based on inventory availability

* Communicate inventory concerns and recommendations to clients



AI, AUTOMATION & SYSTEMS



AI should already be part of how you work, not something you are just beginning to learn.



You should be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar AI platforms to improve:



* Data and search-term analysis

* Keyword classification

* Listing optimization

* Research

* Spreadsheet work

* Problem solving

* Client communication preparation

* Workflow efficiency



You must also understand that AI output needs to be reviewed and validated before it is implemented.



Peak ROAS has developed internal automations and SaaS tools to improve campaign management and account analysis. You must be comfortable learning and working within structured systems and processes.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Understand Amazon deeply enough to explain why something is happening, not simply report numbers

* Are comfortable taking ownership of client relationships

* Communicate problems proactively

* Can confidently discuss both positive and negative performance with clients

* Think analytically and solve problems independently

* Can move comfortably between PPC, catalog, listings, promotions, and inventory

* Use systems, automation, and AI to make yourself more effective

* Follow established processes while identifying opportunities to improve them

* Take accountability for your work and follow through on commitments



Strong Amazon technical skills without strong client communication skills will not be sufficient for this position.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time remote position.



You must be consistently available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM Pacific Time for client communication, internal collaboration,
, chat, and video meetings.



For candidates located in the Philippines, please understand that this is an overnight work schedule.



COMPENSATION



Compensation will depend on your experience, Amazon expertise, and demonstrated ability to independently manage client relationships.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position with the opportunity to grow into greater account ownership and responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words: PEAK CLIENT MANAGER



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many years have you worked directly managing Amazon accounts?



2. What is the largest number of Amazon accounts you have managed at the same time?



3. Briefly describe your experience with Amazon PPC bulk files.



4. Briefly describe one difficult Amazon catalog or listing problem you personally solved.



5. What AI tools do you currently use, and how do you use them in your Amazon work?



6. Include a link to a 1–2 minute Loom video introducing yourself and briefly explaining your Amazon experience as if you were speaking to a client.



Please use at least 10 Apply Points when applying.



Applicants who do not begin their application with “PEAK CLIENT MANAGER,” answer all six questions, and use at least 10 Apply Points will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured evaluation process designed to assess Amazon advertising knowledge, catalog experience, analytical thinking, communication ability, and overall account-management readiness.



Because this is a client-facing position, candidates who advance should expect the interview process to include a live conversation evaluating their ability to clearly explain Amazon strategy and account performance.

title: QuickBooks Online Bookkeeper for Two U.S. Companies

title: AI Automation & Internal Tools Specialist — Claude, Make.com, APIs, Dashboards
description:
## AI Automation & Internal Tools Specialist — Claude, 
, APIs, Dashboards



We are looking for a highly resourceful **AI Automation & Internal Tools Specialist** to help us automate and improve operations across our e-commerce, fulfillment, and marketing businesses.



We use **Claude heavily** to build systems, troubleshoot problems, create workflows, work with APIs, and develop internal tools. We are looking for someone who knows how to use AI as a serious working tool—not just for writing prompts.



Your job is to look at repetitive or inefficient processes and figure out how to automate, simplify, or build a better system for them.



### What You’ll Work On



Projects will vary depending on what the company needs.



Examples include:



* Use Claude to plan, build, troubleshoot, and improve automations

* Build workflows in 
, n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms

* Use Claude Code or similar AI development tools to build internal tools

* Build simple apps and dashboards for our team

* Connect APIs, webhooks, databases, Google Sheets, Slack, Shopify, and other platforms

* Automate client onboarding and status tracking

* Automate Slack reminders and internal notifications

* Build lead-generation and outreach systems

* Automate social media posting and content workflows

* Create reporting dashboards

* Build tools for our fulfillment/3PL operation

* Create systems that monitor problems and alert the team automatically

* Improve existing workflows created with Claude or automation platforms

* Troubleshoot broken automations and integrations

* Document important systems and SOPs



### Examples of Projects



You may be asked to:



* Build a dashboard showing every client, onboarding status, ad account status, and current blockers

* Automatically remind tea
mbers when something is missing from a client

* Build a lead-generation workflow using Claude and external tools

* Automate social media creation, approval, scheduling, and posting

* Connect Shopify orders to internal dashboards or fulfillment systems

* Build a simple internal app instead of managing everything through spreadsheets

* Use an API that does not have an existing 
 integration

* Take a manual process our team currently spends hours doing and automate most of it



### What We're Looking For



You should be very comfortable using **Claude** to solve technical and operational problems.



Experience with several of these is preferred:



* Claude / Anthropic

* Claude Code

* AI-assisted coding

* 

* n8n

* Zapier

* APIs

* Webhooks

* JSON

* Google Sheets

* Slack

* Shopify

* Airtable / databases

* JavaScript

* Python

* Dashboard or internal app builders



You do **not** need to be an expert programmer.



We care more about whether you can use Claude and other tools to figure things out, test your work, and deliver a working solution.



### The Type of Person We Want



We want someone who:



* Is extremely resourceful

* Uses Claude beyond basic prompting

* Can take a business problem and figure out how to solve it

* Researches solutions independently

* Learns new tools quickly

* Tests everything before saying it is finished

* Can troubleshoot when something breaks

* Understands APIs and integrations

* Can explain technical systems simply

* Looks for things that should be automated without always being told



We do not want someone who needs step-by-step instructions for every project.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction.

2. How you currently use Claude in your work.

3. Your experience with Claude Code or AI-assisted development.

4. Three examples of automations, dashboards, apps, or internal systems you personally built.

5. For each example, briefly explain:



   * The problem

   * What you built

   * What tools you used

   * The result

6. Your experience with 
, n8n, APIs, and webhooks.

7. Whether you can work with JavaScript or Python.

8. One example of something you built primarily with the help of Claude.



Start your application with:



**CLAUDE BUILDER**



Selected applicants may be given a small practical test where we provide a business problem and ask you to propose or build a solution.

mbers

Information management

Customer/Vendor relations



Communications/Interactions 

Team Lead – daily

As appropriate to team structure … All administrative team members



Knowledge/Skills 

Strong written and verbal communication skills (English language)

Exceptional organizational and project management abilities

Bookkeeping skills

Great ability to focus

Concerned about doing things the right way

Calm under pressure

Learning based 

Service-based attitude

Before applying, please read all requirements carefully. If you do not meet the requirements below, please do not apply.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



You must have at least 1 year of actual experience working as a Personal Injury Case Manager.



Your experience must involve personal injury cases in at least one of the following states:



Nevada

Arizona

California

8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Nevada Pacific Time



This is a full time position.



You must be available and actively working during the required hours.



NO MULTIPLE FULL TIME JOBS



You cannot work another full time job during our working hours.



We expect your full attention during the hours you are being paid to work for our law firm.



If we discover that you intentionally hid another job that interferes with your work for our firm, your employment may be terminated immediately. Fraud, misuse of confidential information, falsification of work records, or other unlawful conduct may also result in appropriate legal action.

AI IS NOT ALLOWED FOR YOUR WORK

SALARY AND RAISES

title: AI TikTok Video Creator
description:
Ongoing freelance / part-time role with potential to grow



We’re looking for a talented and creative AI video creator to help us build a TikTok channel around a new parenting app.



The concept is simple:



Our app turns good behaviour and daily routines into a game.



Your job will be to create high-retention, AI-generated TikTok/Reels videos aimed primarily at parents.



The videos will typically start with a relatable parenting problem:



- Child having a meltdown

- Refusing to get dressed

- Refusing to brush their teeth

- Bedtime arguments

- Parents repeating themselves 10 times

- Screen-time battles

- Children ignoring instructions

- Parents feeling like they've run out of options



The video then introduces our reward system/app as the solution.



We want content that feels like TikTok content first and advertising second.



You'll use AI video, AI voices, editing, music, sound effects, captions and other tools to turn our concepts/scripts into engaging short-form videos.



We're looking for someone who:



- Has experience creating TikTok, Reels or Shorts

- Is VERY comfortable using AI video generation tools

- Can create realistic AI people/scenes

- Understands the importance of the first 1–3 seconds

- Can edit quickly and dynamically

- Understands TikTok-style captions and text overlays

- Can take a simple concept and make it visually interesting

- Understands emotional storytelling

- Can create multiple creative variations efficiently

- Is interested in learning what performs and improving based on the data



Experience with tools such as Kling, Veo, Runway, Sora, CapCut, ElevenLabs or similar is useful, but we're more interested in the quality of your output than which tools you use.



What we're NOT looking for



We don't want generic corporate videos.



We don't want obvious stock footage with captions added.



We don't want videos that immediately feel like advertisements.



We're looking for someone who understands why people stop scrolling.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small test video.



If you're successful, there will be ongoing work producing multiple videos every week, with the opportunity to become the main creative person behind the account.



When applying, please send:



1. Examples of AI videos you've personally created

2. Examples of TikTok/Reels/Shorts you've edited

3. The AI tools you currently use

4. How many short-form videos you could realistically produce per week

5. Your expected hourly or per-video rate



Please start your application with the words PURPLE GEM so we know you've read the full job description.

I am specifically looking for someone with 3–5+ years of verifiable experience directly supporting a CEO, founder, entrepreneur, or senior executive. I am not looking to train someone how to become an Executive Assistant.



The right person should be able to step into my life, identify what is disorganized or inefficient, and recommend the systems and processes needed to keep both my professional and personal life running smoothly.

* Experience managing both professional and personal responsibilities

title: Marketing and Operations Manager (Right Hand) for DTC ecom Brand - $1,500+ USD Monthly
description:
Become the Right Hand to an 8-Figure Founding Team (And Build a Long-Term Future With Us)



We're an 8-figure health & wellness eCommerce brand - and we're looking for one sharp, organized person to grow with us for years.



Most job posts want a specialist. We want a mind we can trust.



Here's the truth: we can teach you everything you need to know. Marketing, media buying, copywriting, funnel building, conversion optimization - all of it. What we can't teach is how to think. How to stay organized. How to work hard and figure things out without being told twice.



So if you're smart, driven, and hungry to learn - even if you're not a marketing expert yet - keep reading. That's exactly what we're hiring for.



- The Position: Executive Assistant - Marketing & Operations (Trained Into Hands-On CMO)

- The Company: 8-figure health & wellness eCommerce brand (50% Germany, 50% USA)

- The Niche: Sleep, pain relief, and health products that genuinely change lives

- Location: 100% Remote

- Compensation: $1,500/month to start - with no ceiling, really. It goes as far as you take it.



What You'll Actually Be Doing



This is primarily a hands-on marketing role - with a heavy focus on writing. But you'll also help us build structure, sharpen processes, and grow our team as we scale. You'll be our right hand across the business.



Don't worry if some of this is new. As you learn, you'll take on more. Here's what your weeks will eventually look like:



- Writing scripts, ads, and copy using proven Direct Response principles (this is core - you must love writing)

- Optimizing conversion rates and running A/B tests that move real numbers

- Bringing structure and processes into how we run marketing

- Overseeing video editors - reviewing their work, giving revisions, keeping quality high

- Editing funnels with drag-and-drop tools

- Media buying across Meta & Google Ads

- Product testing using our internal templates

- Helping build the team as we grow



The first weeks and months have one goal: learn as much as humanly possible.



The end goal: you become a core operator we rely on completely.



Why This Role Is Different



We're not looking for someone to fill a seat. We're looking for someone to invest in - and build with for the long haul.



You'll be personally trained by us - an 8-figure founding team - in the exact skills that build wealth in this industry:



- Copywriting (Scripts, Advertorials, VSLs, Native Ads)

- Media Buying (Meta & Google Ads)

- Video Editing (Understanding what makes creatives convert)

- Product Testing (Using our proven internal templates)

- Funnel Building (Drag-and-drop web design)

- CVR Optimization (A/B testing and beyond)



This is a paid education worth more than any MBA. You don't need to walk in knowing all of this - you need to be the kind of person who can learn it fast.



Who We're Actually Looking For



Read this carefully, because it matters far more than your résumé:



- You're genuinely smart. You learn fast and connect dots others miss. This is the #1 thing we care about.

- You're a strong writer. Your English is flawless, and you genuinely enjoy writing. Non-negotiable.

- You're organized. You bring order to chaos. Systems and processes come naturally to you.

- You work hard. Not "I show up" hard - "I obsess over getting it right" hard.

- You're independent. You don't wait to be told what to do. You find the work and do it.

- You're loyal. You want to grow WITH a company. We have huge plans for the next few years, and we want someone who wants to be part of that story.



We've hired brilliant people from all kinds of backgrounds. What matters most is that you're sharp, driven, and already know your way around the eCommerce or online marketing world.



If you need hand-holding, this isn't for you. If you want to plant roots and build something real, keep reading.



Minimum Requirements

- You've worked at an online marketing agency OR an eCommerce brand. This is a must - you already understand how this world works. (Whatever your exact role was - marketing, ops, organization, assistant - we're open.)

- Fluent, exceptional English - you write clearly and persuasively

Comfortable with tools like Shopify, Canva, and social media (you don't need to be an expert - just comfortable and quick to learn)

- You use AI daily (Claude / ChatGPT) - not occasionally

- Fluent with modern tools (Slack, Notion, and whatever's new)

- Notice what's NOT here: years of deep marketing experience. That's what we'll teach you. We care far more about raw intelligence and work ethic than a perfect track record.



Why This Changes Your Life



For the right person, this isn't a job. It's a partnership. You start at $1,500/month, but for hard workers who prove themselves, there's no ceiling. As we grow, you grow. As the brand grows into a portfolio, so does your role - and your income.



We're looking for ONE person. A long-term partner. Someone we can pour knowledge into and build the next chapter with.



How to Apply



Keep it short and to the point. We only want three things:



1.) Your background: Did you work at an online marketing agency or an eCommerce brand? Tell us your role and what you actually accomplished.



2.) Largest team: What's the biggest team you've managed or coordinated?



3.) Motivation: What makes you want THIS role, long-term?



No long essays. Just the essentials, clearly written.



We read every application personally. Show us you're the one.



Application tip: Show, don't tell. Specific examples beat generic statements.



We're hiring ONE person for a long-term partnership. Quality applications only

title: AI Designer (Web & Dashboards) | Full-Time, Long-Term
description:
I run a fast-growing AI consulting business serving high-profile entrepreneurs in the German-speaking market. We help them work with Claude and we build the systems that run their business, and right now my developers can build faster than we can design. Three client sites are sitting on hold because there is nobody to design them, and our dashboards, the ones clients actually log into, still look like something a developer put together between two other jobs.



I am hiring one designer who owns all of it. This is not a role where you hand a pretty file to somebody else and hope they build it correctly. You design it and you build it, with AI doing the heavy lifting and your judgment d
 what ships.





Who you'll work with



You work directly with me and with a small, tight team of developers, an executive assistant and a copywriter, all full-time, all on OnlineJobs.ph like you. We have a short daily check-in and a written end-of-day report from everyone. You and the copywriter work from the same brief, in parallel, so a piece of content and its visuals come together instead of one waiting on the other. Clear structures, fast decisions, no corporate politics.





What you will do



- Design and build the client sites that are currently on hold, in HTML and CSS, AI-assisted

- Design our dashboards and our cockpit, internal and client-facing: panels, tables, charts, numbers that a busy person has to be able to read in seconds

- Build landing pages with AI tools, quickly and cleanly

- Create the visuals for our content, made yourself or generated

- Generate images and short video as supporting material, and keep iterating until it is actually right

- Apply our design systems consistently across everything, so our work looks like one company





What matters most to me



One thing above everything: judgment of your own.

AI hands you a first result in about ten seconds, and that first result is almost never the one that should go in front of a client. The person I hire knows the difference between a design that is finished and a design that only looks finished, and can tell me in two lines why they went with this version instead of the four they threw away. If your process is one prompt and whatever comes back, we will both be unhappy.



And as with everyone on my team: honesty and reliability. When you tell me something is done and checked, I need to fully trust that. "Done" has to mean done and tested, in the browser, on a phone as well.



My clients are in the German-speaking market, so data protection and security are always at the highest level.





Must-have



- HTML and CSS at build level, not visual layout only: you can build the page yourself (proof required)

- You work with AI every day, not occasionally

- Image and video generation with real judgment on when to iterate and when to stop (proof required)

- AI-assisted site and page building

- Interface design for data: panels, tables, charts, dashboards

- You apply an existing design system instead of reinventing it on every project

- Written English good enough for briefs and reviews

- Honest and reliable





Nice to have



- Short-form video editing

- A feel for typography in German text, where the words are longer and a layout that worked in English suddenly breaks





What we offer



- Full-time, long-term, with real ownership of how our work looks from day one

- Direct daily contact with me and a steep learning curve in AI and business

- A performance culture: I don't care about hours, I care about the result. Strong, fast work is rewarded with raises, quickly





Hours



We work on Gulf Standard Time (Dubai, GMT+4). Team hours are 10 AM to 6 PM Dubai time, which is 2 PM to 10 PM your time in the Philippines. The whole team works the same hours. Short daily check-in, and a short written end-of-day report every day.





Compensation



Starting salary $800 USD/month, full-time, long-term. We start lean. Performance is rewarded fast: above-average work means steady raises and growing income over time.



Who should not apply



Please don't apply if you design in Figma and then hand the file to a developer. In this role the person who designs it is the person who builds it. Don't apply if you are a brand and corporate identity specialist hoping for logo work, because that is not what this job is. Don't apply if you are a general virtual assistant who also makes graphics on the side. And don't apply if you have never really worked with AI tools, because the whole role is built on top of them.



You do not need experience in the AI industry, you do not need to know how the models work internally, you do not need classical design training if your digital work is strong, and you do not need German.



How to apply



Don't send me a long message or a portfolio yet. Just reply with "I'm in" plus ONE sentence on why you are the right person for this role. That's it. I answer everyone, and I'll send you the next step directly.

 what to write. And don't apply if your writing process is prompting an AI and shipping what comes back.

This is a fixed scope project with potential for long term work on updates and future games if the first project goes well.

Cursed Garden combines the proven farming loop of Grow a Garden with a night survival mechanic that no current Roblox game executes properly. Players plant seeds, grow crops offline, harvest and sell at a market during the day — then defend their most valuable plants from creatures that emerge at night. The most valuable crops take the longest to grow and attract the most dangerous creatures. That tension is the entire game.



What You Will Receive



A complete developer brief covering every mechanic, creature, defence system, monetisation system, and milestone in detail

Reference games to study before starting

Clear milestone schedule with payment at each milestone

Trello board for project management

WhatsApp communication throughout

Ability to build creature pathfinding that handles 20 to 30 simultaneous players without lag

Experience with DataStore2 or equivalent for offline growth persistence

Experience integrating Roblox MarketplaceService for game passes and developer products

Ability to deliver a complete polished game in 4 weeks

Mobile, PC, and console compatibility

Responsive communication via WhatsApp

Trello account for project management

Wise account for payment



Payment

$620 AUD total paid in three milestones via Wise:



30% upfront ($186 AUD) to begin

40% at working prototype ($248 AUD) — day phase and night phase both functional

30% at final delivery ($186 AUD) — fully polished, monetised, and tested

To Apply

title: Website & Tech VA Needed — WordPress Experience Required
description:
I am looking for an experienced Virtual Assistant who loves the technical side of online business and takes real pride in getting things done beautifully.



I am building a personal brand coaching business with a big heart behind it. My work is about helping women fall back in love with themselves, and I want my business to reflect that same energy, including the people I work with.



I am not just looking for someone to complete tasks. I am looking for someone who genuinely enjoys what they do, takes ownership of their work, and wants to be part of something meaningful as it grows. If you are the kind of person who lights up when a tricky tech problem gets solved, and who feels proud when a website page looks exactly right — we are going to get along really well.



Tool experience required:

- You must have hands-on experience with WordPress!

- The website is hosted with Bluehost, the theme I use in WP is Kadence and payments run through Stripe. Experience with these is a bonus but not required.



- You must have experience managing an
 marketing platform (MailerLite, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or similar). I currently work in MailerLite, so experience there is a plus. But what matters most is that you're comfortable managing this type of tool independently and can pick up a new one quickly and confidently on your own time.



Please do not apply if you are not familiar with WordPress.



You are the right person if you:

— Can build and update website pages with confidence, following design guidelines and direction

— Can build new pages that match an established design system (colors, fonts, layout) without needing creative direction on look and feel

— Are comfortable connecting platforms and setting up backend integrations

— Work independently and figure things out without needing constant hand-holding

— Are reliable, honest, and follow through on what you say you will do

— Communicate proactively — I never want to wonder what is happening

— Can document your processes clearly so we build systems together



What the role involves:

— Building a priority waitlist landing page

— Setting up a waitlist confirmation/thank-you page with redirect

— Connecting MailerLite to the waitlist signup form

— Building a checkout page and connecting it to the payment processor (Stripe)

— Building a purchase confirmation/thank-you page

— Setting up a password-protected members-only portal

— Building a sales page

— All pages built from my copy, layout specs, and design direction — following established design elements and patterns

— Backend tech setup — connecting payment processors,
 integrations, and other platforms as needed

— Building and maintaining a simple process document as we go



If this sounds like you, please reply with a short description of your experience with WordPress and online business tech, and your favourite inspirational quote.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a brief video interview. The next step after that is a paid trial assignment. Through this assignment, we will both get a feel for how we work together, and afterward we will d
 whether to continue long-term. If it's a good fit, this becomes a long-term role with consistent work and room to grow together.

title: Commercial Real Estate Researcher
description:
Principle is a multidisciplinary commercial real estate firm in York, Pennsylvania, working across appraisal and valuation, property tax consulting, brokerage, and capital advisory. We are a three-generation appraisal practice, and our work is relied on by lenders, attorneys, taxing authorities, and courts.



The role



Every appraisal, tax appeal, and advisory opinion we produce rests on facts about real property: who owns it, what was paid, how large it is, what it's assessed at, how it's zoned, what sold nearby and on what terms.



This role establishes those facts — not looks them up, establishes them. Property data comes from many sources and those sources routinely disagree. The assessor says the building is 14,000 square feet. The deed describes a parcel that doesn't match the map. A commercial database reports a price the recorded instrument doesn't support. Knowing which source governs, and being able to say why, is the actual work.



Bad property data doesn't announce itself. It surfaces in a review, a reconsideration request, or under cross-examination — and by then it's expensive. This position exists to catch it first.



What you'll do

Establish and verify property facts from U.S. public records — deeds, assessment and tax records, plats, and recorded instruments

Read and interpret deeds: chain of title, deed types, consideration and transfer tax, easements and restrictions

Determine which source governs when sources conflict, and document why

Develop and verify comparable sales, leases, and listings, screening each for conditions that compromise comparability

Compile assessment, millage, common level ratio, and appeal calendar data by county

Work county GIS, assessor portals, and recorder systems fluently, including the poorly built ones

Build research files with a complete source log — every material fact traceable to a source, a reference, and a date

Maintain our comparable database and county reference materials so verified work is reusable

What we're looking for



Required



Prior experience in real estate research, title, land records, assessment, or a comparable records-intensive field

Working understanding of U.S. real estate concepts and terminology

Experience reviewing tax assessment records and property data

Ability to read and interpret deeds and legal descriptions, or clear capacity to learn quickly

Exceptional attention to detail, and the patience to keep searching when the obvious source doesn't have the answer

Strong written English — you'll produce documentation others rely on and defend

Strong spreadsheet skills and comfort with structured data



Preferred



Experience supporting U.S. appraisal firms, brokerages, or property tax consultants

Familiarity with county assessor and recorder sites and public record databases

Background in valuation, property tax, or real estate analytics

Experience with CoStar, Reonomy, Pictometry, or MLS

What we're really selecting for



Someone who finds a three-way discrepancy between sources interesting rather than annoying, and who wants to know why two records disagree even after the assignment no longer requires it. That person produces materially better research than someone who merely completes the task.



And someone who reports what the research shows regardless of whether it helps. If a comparable is unhelpful, it still gets reported. If a fact can't be verified, you say so plainly. That standard isn't negotiable here — it's why our work holds up when it's examined.

title: Youtube Long form video editor
description:
**Workload:** 4–6 long-form videos per month (minimum one per week)

**Bonus skill:** Thumbnail design

**Start:** As soon as possible — one video is ready to go now for the right candidate

**Budget:** Up to $350USD (500CAD$)/month (this is my ceiling, not a target — a strong candidate at a lower rate is very welcome)

**Turnaround:** Up to 5 business days per video from the time raw footage is shared (exact scheduling worked out together once we start)



**About the Channel**



I run a YouTube channel and coaching business focused on feminine embodiment and detoxification. My content blends deep educational teaching with a devotional, feminine tone — think long-form talking-head videos, guided audio activations, and personal-story-driven teaching. I'm not chasing viral hooks or fast cuts; I'm building a channel that feels like a trusted, grounded voice in a noisy space.

I'm looking for a long-term editing partner, not a one-off gig. If we're a good fit, this is a relationship I want to invest in and grow with over time — including more volume and more responsibility down the line.



**The Role**

You'll be the primary sole editor for my long-form YouTube content — typically 15–30+ minute videos. This is the bulk of the work. I will have some short-form in the future once we nail the long form part.



**Core responsibilities:**

- Edit long-form talking-head and voiceover videos from raw footage to final 4k export

- Apply clean, minimal cuts — tightening pacing without adding flashy effects

- Basic color correction and audio cleanup (leveling, noise reduction)

- Light B-roll integration and simple lower-thirds/captions where appropriate

- Maintain a consistent visual style across videos

- Turn around each video within 5 business days of receiving raw footage (we'll discuss this)

- (Bonus) Design YouTube thumbnails aligned with brand style (check my recent ones for beginning point)



**Editing Style — Please Read Carefully**

This is the most important part of this posting, so I want to be specific:

- **Minimal editing.** No sound effects, no whooshes, no dings, no 
-style zooms.

- **This is not short-attention-span content.** These are deep, educational, long-form videos. The edit should not distract from the message — the goal is to *disappear* in service of the content, not to entertain on its own.

- **Feminine, embodied, deep — not high-energy or hyper-produced.** Think Dan Koe's YouTube channel as a north star, not MrBeast. Calm, intentional pacing. Clean typography if any text is used. Subtle, tasteful transitions if any.

- I'll provide reference videos from my own channel to show the direction we're heading, plus 2–3 outside examples if helpful.



**What I'm Looking For**

**Must-haves:**

- Proven experience editing long-form YouTube content (not just Reels/TikTok/Shorts)

- A portfolio of editing style 

- Strong sense of pacing for spoken-word, educational content

- Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times

- Comfortable with your own editing software of choice — I currently edit in Descript myself, but you're welcome to use whatever software you're most efficient in (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Descript, etc.), as long as final exports meet spec



**Nice-to-haves:**

- Thumbnail design skills

- Experience editing wellness, personal-development content

- Familiarity with feminine/soft aesthetic brand styles



**How to Apply**

Please send:

1. **2–3 examples of long-form video edits** (ideally 10+ minutes)

2. **A thumbnail portfolio**, if applicable

3. A short note on your availability and which editing software you work in (any software is fine)

4. Your rate (per video or monthly retainer) — budget for this role is up to $500 CAD/month for 4–6 videos, so please share what you'd charge within that range

**Optional but appreciated:** a note on why this style of editing appeals to you — I want someone who genuinely enjoys this kind of work

title: Short-Form Video Editor — Vertical Content (Long-Term)
description:
I'm a full-time content creator producing short-form vertical video across a range of products and niches. I post daily and I film everything myself.



I edit everything myself right now and I've hit my ceiling. I'm looking for one editor to take editing off my plate long-term so I can focus on filming and strategy.



This is not a "make it look cool" job. I have an established editing style that my audience responds to. Your job is to replicate it exactly, not to improve on it or bring your own aesthetic. If you're an editor who wants creative freedom, this isn't the role — and that's fair to figure out early for both of us.



TikTok familiarity is non-negotiable. Not "I've seen TikToks." I mean you actively use the app, you know what current editing conventions look like, you know where the UI covers the screen, and you know instinctively where text should sit so it isn't blocked. If you don't use TikTok regularly, please don't apply — I'll be able to tell within one edit.



What you'll do



Edit vertical videos from raw footage (typically 3–8 min raw ? 20–60 sec final)

Match my established style — pacing, cuts, zooms, captions, sound

Color correct for consistent skin tone and accurate product color across mixed lighting

Keyframe zooms and punch-ins timed to emphasis

Caption styling — clean, minimal, aesthetic, correctly placed in TikTok safe zones

Place b-roll I provide (you will not be sourcing b-roll)

Audio leveling and occasional SFX (no music)

Deliver 4K vertical, 2160x3840, 9:16, no watermarks, ready to post

Organize and name files in shared Google Drive per my system



Video styles you'll be editing



Style What it is

Talking head Me on camera speaking directly

Faceless Product/hands only, no face on screen

B-roll Footage-driven, cut to provided b-roll

Comparison Two-option or before/after structure

Voiceover I provide the script and record the VO myself; you cut to it



Requirements



Proven short-form vertical editing work — TikTok, Reels, or Shorts. Long-form YouTube and wedding reels don't tell me what I need to know.

Active, regular TikTok user

Comfortable in [CapCut Pro / Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve — your pick, as long as you deliver clean 4K exports and can hand over project files]

Machine that can handle 4K source footage without choking

24-hour turnaround, Monday–Friday. Anything I submit before 5pm CST is due by 5pm CST the next business day. Submitted after 5pm Friday = due Monday.

Reliable internet

Available for async communication on weekdays

English proficiency sufficient for accurate caption timing and understanding revision notes



Compliance — please read



My content is subject to TikTok Shop rules. You will never add on-screen text, graphics, or claims that weren't in the script I provide. No price mentions, no product comparisons, no "dupe" language, no health or medical claims, no off-platform links. A violation can suppress my entire account, so this is the one area where "I thought it looked better" is not an acceptable reason.



Nice to have (not required)



Experience editing affiliate or TikTok Shop content

Cover frame / thumbnail selection

Interest in growing into VA work later 
 management, content repurposing) — I expect to expand this role once editing is running smoothly, at additional pay



Details



Hours: 20 hrs/week to start, Monday–Friday

Rate: $6–10/hour USD depending on experience and test results

Payment: Wise, paid every Friday

Trial: First two weeks are a paid trial, then ongoing

Term: Long-term. I'm hiring one person to grow with, not filling a gap.

Location: Remote, any timezone. I'm in CST — if you're ahead of me, that's a plus.

Rights: I own all footage, edits, and project files. Project files delivered on request. No portfolio use of my content without my written permission, per video.

Applications that skip these steps get deleted without a reply.



1. Start your message with the number 24 followed by how many finished videos you can realistically complete in a 20–25 hour week, alongside your current clients. Be honest — I'd rather know your real number than your best-case one. (Example: 24 / 30)



2. Send links to three vertical short-form videos you personally edited. For each, tell me in one sentence what you actually did on it — I want to know your work, not your agency's.

title: Video Editor (AI Native)
description:
The Role

We are searching for a number of freelance video editors who can produce social video ads end to end: generating footage and assets with AI video platforms (Higgsfield, Kling, Veo and similar), and editing them into finished vertical ads for TikTok and Instagram, complete with captions, on-screen text, sound effects and music. You will work from an approved script, an editor brief and a set of references on every job. Confident daily use of video generation models is central to the role, as well as creative judgement. The brief sets the direction, and you bring the ideas, taste and craft that make the ad worth watching. 



*** Outstanding editors can earn $500 - $1000 USD+ a week!



About Us

We are a UK-based production agency creating social video ads for consumer brands, including well-known names in beauty, wellness, sport and consumer goods. 



Main Responsibilities

- Editing paid social video ads from our scripts and editor briefs.

- Generating A-roll and B-roll using AI video platforms, following our prompts and art direction.

- Adding native-style captions, on-screen text, sound design and music to brief.

- Understanding the technicals of production and delivering based on video specifications 

- Following briefs exactly and delivering on time, every time.

- Revising edits based on feedback, quickly and without drama.



Essential Requirements:

You must have skills in all of the following. If you do not have these skills, you will not be considered.



- AI video generation. You use AI video tools as a core part of your workflow including Nano Banana Pro, GPT Image 2, Kling 3.0, Gemini Omni, ElevenLabs, Suno, Seedance 2.5). You understand image-to-video, keyframes and prompting fundamentals. 



- Social-native editing. You understand paid social on TikTok and Instagram: pacing, hooks, native captions, and what makes an ad feel at home in the feed.



- Editing craft. Strong direct editing skills in Premiere Pro, and the discipline to work to deadlines.



- Creativity. You bring ideas and taste to every edit, not just execution.



- Native-level English. You understand a brief first time, and your on-screen text is flawless. Bonus points if you can understand different english accents (American, English, Australian etc)



- Speedy Communication. You are very communicative: fast replies during working hours, active on Slack and WhatsApp every day, with at least 2 hours of overlap with the UK morning (approximately 4:00pm to 6:00pm Philippine Time).

Reliability. You follow briefs, work fast, and deliver on time without being chased.



Desirable

- Experience editing paid social ads for e-commerce or DTC brands.

- An understanding of the paid advertising concepts

- Problem solving skills



What We Offer



- Per-video pay with no ceiling:

You are paid per approved video, not per hour. The more quality work you deliver, the more you earn, and there is no cap. Fast turnarounds on approved work earn bonuses on top.

Strong performers can receive several videos per week and priority on new briefs with potential to earn $1000+ per week



- Well-known brands:

Your ads will run on some globally recognised brand channels



- Genuinely Creative work:

This is a truly creative role where you will use the best AI video models in the industry, at the frontier of where advertising is going. If you love this technology, and want to work in a frontier sector, this is a role where you get paid to be great at it.



- Opportunity to grow. We are scaling, and the editors who prove themselves get more volume, higher-value productions and a bigger roles, responsibility and earning potential as we expand.



- Assistance along the way. Scripts, briefs, reference videos, art direction and structured feedback are all supplied on every job. You focus on the edit.



How to Apply

Answer these four questions and provide the requested links below:



1. Which AI tools, models and platforms do you use regularly?

2. Which tools or models do you prefer for A-roll (people talking to camera) versus B-roll (products, environments, action), and why?

3. How would you create a highly realistic human avatar with AI? Which models currently give the most human-like results?

4. What is the most common giveaway that a shot is AI-generated, and how do you fix it in your own work?



Please also provide at least two or three links to past work, including paid social ads you have produced. Links must open without login or access requirements

title: Freelance Content Creator — Men's Fashion Carousels (TikTok/IG)
description:
About Us

We 
 a growing men's fashion tiktok page focused on outfit inspiration — flat-lay carousels that break down looks for different occasions and situations. We're looking for a reliable, detail-oriented freelancer to help us post consistently, every day.



What You'll Do

You'll take inspiration from a list of reference pages we give you and turn their outfit ideas into original carousels for our brand — same style of layout, refreshed pieces, posted on schedule.



Daily steps:



1. Check the pages — Look at the list of reference pages we give you. Find the video/carousel ideas that are doing well right now.

2. Download the slides — Use snaptik.app to download the slides in high quality.

title: SMS Operations Specialist – Routing, Deliverability & List Management
description:
WHY THIS ISN'T A NORMAL SMS ROLE



Most SMS applicants have scheduled blasts inside an all-in-one CRM. That's a different job. We need someone who understands what sits underneath that.



You should be at home with the aggregator layer — Twilio, Bandwidth, Telnyx, Plivo, Sinch or similar — and know how routes differ between them, how throughput and TPS limits actually behave, and what happens to a campaign when a carrier starts filtering.



You should know 10DLC and toll-free verification inside out: brand and campaign registration, vetting scores, why a campaign gets rejected, and how registration status affects delivery.



You should be able to read delivery reports properly. Delivered versus sent versus filtered. Error codes. Where messages are actually dying and what to do about it.





LIST OPERATIONS



This is half the role and we take it seriously.



Ingest and normalise lists at scale — E.164 formatting, dedupe, standardisation across messy source files.



Clean them properly: carrier lookup, mobile versus landline filtering, invalid and disconnected number removal, DNC and litigator scrubbing, suppression list management.



Maintain consent and opt-out records so STOP and HELP handling is airtight and auditable.



Work in SQL, Python or serious spreadsheet tooling. You should be processing hundreds of thousands of records without breaking a sweat or breaking the data.





COMPLIANCE



You need working knowledge of TCPA, CTIA guidelines, quiet hours and the state-level rules that catch people out — Florida and Oklahoma in particular. We want someone who flags a problem before it becomes a legal bill, not after.





TO APPLY



Tell us which aggregators and sending platforms you have worked with directly, and at what volume.



Walk us through your list cleaning process, step by step, including which tools you use for scrubbing.



Describe a deliverability problem you diagnosed and fixed.



Tell us your experience with 10DLC or toll-free registration.



Start your message with the word ROUTES so we know you read this.



Applications without specific platform names and volumes will be deleted unread.

Project Scope

Review my Windows laptop specifications and confirm whether it can support the software.

Recommend the most reliable real-time AI face-swap program for my equipment.

Install and configure the necessary software.

Set up OBS Studio or another virtual-camera solution, if needed.

Connect the finished video feed to:

Zoom

Microsoft Teams

Google Meet

Configure my manager’s likeness using photos or videos that she has voluntarily provided for this authorized demonstration.

Optimize facial tracking, expressions, lighting, camera placement, resolution, and performance.

Test the setup during natural speaking and movement.

Ensure the system can operate during presentations lasting approximately one hour, with several presentations occurring throughout the day.

Teach me how to activate and deactivate the effect.

Show me how to switch back to my normal webcam immediately.

Explain how to troubleshoot common problems, including lagging, freezing, overheating, camera-detection issues, and application crashes.

Complete at least one live test call with me before the project is considered complete.

Required Experience



Applicants should have experience with several of the following:



Real-time AI face swapping or facial reenactment

AI virtual-camera software

OBS Studio and OBS Virtual Camera

Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet

Windows installation and troubleshooting

Webcam and lighting optimization

Live-streaming or virtual-production setups

GPU, CPU, and computer-performance optimization



Experience with tools such as Magicam, Deep-Live-Cam, DeepFaceLive, OBS Studio, or similar programs is strongly preferred.

Payment will be provided after the agreed setup, testing, and training have been completed successfully. The software should function reliably on my computer and connect correctly to Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet.



Any paid software or subscription costs must be discussed and approved before purchase. The $150 payment is for the freelancer’s professional setup and training services.



Estimated Project Time



This will likely require:



One remote setup session

Approximately 2–4 hours of work, depending on installation and troubleshooting

One short follow-up test before the presentation

Important Authorization Notice



This project is for a legitimate internal educational presentation. The person whose likeness will be used is my manager, and she has explicitly consented to participating. The technology will not be used for fraud, harassment, unauthorized impersonation, financial activity, identity verification, or misleading the public.

title: Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About Us



Direct Care Assistance is an Australian NDIS service provider delivering support work, nursing, and

Supported Independent Living (SIL) services. We're building a dedicated, full-time recruitment function to

help us find and hire the right people, faster.



The Role:



We're hiring a full-time, Philippines-based Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Specialist to own our end-to end hiring pipeline, from sourcing and screening through to job ad creation and applicant tracking, and to manage ongoing employee compliance once staff are hired. You'll work closely with our Australia-based Service Delivery Manager and Workforce Coordinator, who make the final call on every hire, while you own everything that gets a strong shortlist in front of them and keeps our staff compliant afterward.



What You'll Do:



• Manage full-cycle recruitment for support workers, nurses, team leaders, SIL house managers, and

operational staff.

• Write and design job ads and recruitment graphics (Canva or similar) for each platform.

• Source candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, referrals, and our existing talent pool.

• Screen and shortlist candidates against role criteria; flag NDIS Worker Screening Check / right-to work status where relevant.

• Keep every candidate's status live and accurate in our ATS, so the Australian team has real-time

visibility into where each role stands.

• Coordinate final-round interviews and hand off shortlists to the Service Delivery Manager and

Workforce Coordinator for final decisions.

• Maintain a warm talent pipeline for roles we hire for repeatedly.

• Provide a brief weekly pipeline status update to the AU team.

• Manage ongoing compliance for current employees: track NDIS Worker Screening Check expiries,

police checks, First Aid/CPR certificates, and other required qualifications, and follow up renewals

before they lapse.

• Keep each employee's compliance status current in the ATS/HR system and flag any upcoming or

overdue lapses to the Service Delivery Manager and Workforce Coordinator.



What We're Looking For:



• 3+ years' full-cycle recruitment or talent acquisition experience: sourcing, screening, and shortlisting,

not just HR admin.

• Experience recruiting for healthcare, aged care, disability support, or BPO/staffing highly regarded.

• Confident working inside an ATS and across multiple job boards.

• Strong written and spoken English. You'll be the first point of contact for candidates.

• Comfortable designing simple recruitment graphics (Canva or equivalent).

• Self-directed and able to own a full pipeline without close supervision.

• Reliable internet and a quiet, professional remote work setup.

• Able to overlap with Australian business hours (AEST).

• Comfortable tracking compliance documents and expiry dates methodically, ideally with prior HR or

compliance administration experience.



Compensation & Details:



• Rate: AUD $10/hour

• Full-time: 40 hours/week

• Fully remote, Philippines-based

• Direct hire, paid fortnightly by direct deposit



Before You Apply:



This role is full-cycle and independent from day one. We're not set up to train someone into recruitment

basics. Please only apply if all of the following are true:



• You have personally sourced, screened, and shortlisted candidates for full-time roles, not just posted

ads or scheduled interviews.

• You are applying knowing the rate is AUD $10/hour, full-time, and are comfortable with that.

• You can overlap with Australian business hours (AEST).



To confirm you've read this in full, begin your application with the words "Ready to Recruit." Applications

that don't include this will not be reviewed.



How to Apply

Submit your resume along with a written answer (150 words max) to this: "You have 48 hours and 50

applicants to turn into a shortlist of 5 for a disability support worker role. Walk me through exactly how

you'd do it." Generic or copy-pasted answers will not progress. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a

screening call; due to volume, only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

Analytics & Reporting

/Instagram) Ads to support future CLP offerings

title: Admin
description:
# Business Development Admin – Immediate Start





**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9am–5pm UK time

**Start Date:** Immediate

**Training Month Salary:** **$200 USD/month**

**Salary Review:** Salary will increase from the following month based on performance and responsibilities.



## About the Role



We are looking for a reliable and ambitious **Business Development Admin** to support the continuous growth and development of our company.



You will work closely with management to help carry out daily business-development tasks, organise information, complete research, update systems and make sure development projects are followed through properly.



This role is ideal for someone who is organised, fast, confident using AI and comfortable handling a variety of business tasks.



## Main Responsibilities



Your daily tasks may include:



* Business and market research

* Competitor research

* Finding potential clients and partners

* Building lead and company lists

* Updating CRM systems and trackers

* Organising development projects

* Following up outstanding tasks

* Creating documents, guides and SOPs

* Using ChatGPT and AI tools for research and administration

* Researching new services and opportunities

* Helping improve internal processes

* Identifying basic issues or bottlenecks and reporting them

* Keeping management updated on progress

* Organising company information and databases

* Supporting sales and business-development activities

* Completing ad-hoc development tasks assigned by management



## What We Need



You should be:



* Highly organised

* Reliable

* Fast at completing tasks

* Comfortable working independently

* Good at online research

* Confident using ChatGPT and AI tools

* Able to follow instructions accurately

* Able to communicate clearly in English

* Comfortable learning new systems

* Willing to take initiative

* Able to identify when something is incomplete or causing delays

* Available during UK working hours



You do not need to already know everything about property or business development.



What matters most is that you can **learn quickly, research properly, organise information and get tasks completed without needing constant supervision.**



## Typical Daily Workflow



You may receive development tasks such as:



**“Research 30 potential strategic partners.”**



**“Create a list of companies we can approach for this service.”**



**“Research how competitors offer this service.”**



**“Update our business-development tracker.”**



**“Turn this process into an SOP.”**



**“Find what is causing this task to be delayed and report back.”**



Your responsibility is to complete the task properly, organise the information and report the result clearly.



## Career Progression



The first month is a **training month at $200 USD**.



Strong performers can receive increased pay and greater responsibility from the following month.



There is potential to progress into:



* Senior Business Development Admin

* Business Development Executive

* Business Development Coordinator

* Operations Coordinator

* Business Development Manager



We want someone who can grow with the company long term.



## How to Apply

1. Your CV

2. A short introduction

3. Confirmation that you can work **9am–5pm UK time**

4. Confirmation that you are comfortable using ChatGPT/AI

5. Confirmation that you can **start immediately**



At the top of your application write:



**“READY TO DEVELOP”**



Whatsapp

# Content Operations Manager: Six Local Publications



**$1,600-$2,000/month | Full-time | Remote | Long-term**



## About us



We operate six local news publications and matching Instagram accounts across Georgia and Florida.



We cover local news, business openings, events, development, and useful information for people who live in each community. Local businesses also partner with us to reach those readers.



We are hiring one person to take ownership of our recurring publishing and content operations.

### Instagram



You will produce one carousel post for each of our six accounts every weekday.



For each post, you will:



* Find a relevant local story

* Verify the information using reliable sources

* Write the headline and body copy using our existing format

* Build the slides from our Canva templates

* Schedule or publish the finished post

* Save the source links used



### Newsletters



We publish eight editions per week.



Five editions arrive already drafted. You will move them into Beehiiv, format each section, check every link, add the thumbnail image, and schedule the send.



Three Athens editions require more editorial work. You will select local stories, write short summaries, and build the events calendar using our existing process.



### Partner operations

* Request photos and materials from local business partners

* Follow up when something is late

* Format approved advertisements inside Beehiiv

* Keep the publishing schedule and partner database updated in Notion

* Make sure no scheduled placement is forgotten



You will not be responsible for sales or account strategy.

## What success looks like



* Newsletters and Instagram posts go out on schedule

* Facts, names, dates, links, and locations are correct

* The writing can be published without being rewritten

* Partner materials are collected before their deadlines

* Notion reflects what is actually scheduled

* Problems are raised early, before they become missed deadlines



## Requirements



* At least two years of remote experience in content, publishing, operations, or executive assistance
