AI tools are allowed, but not as a replacement for real skill



We are not against AI. We use AI heavily and have access to many advanced AI tools, coding tools, APIs, and research systems.



You may use AI to help with debugging, analysis, documentation, research, planning, code review, and efficiency.



However, you cannot use AI as a substitute for knowing what you are doing. If you are hired as a developer, you must understand the code, structure, security, database logic, permissions, workflows, and systems you are working on.



Do not apply as a developer if your only ability is asking ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Kimi, Gemini, Codex, or another AI tool to build everything for you.



AI should help you move faster. It should not be the only reason you can do the work.



Some of the systems we are building may involve sensitive data, financial technology, business intelligence, user accounts, APIs, integrations, and security sensitive infrastructure. Poor code, weak database logic, bad permissions, bad security, or blindly copied AI code can create serious risk.



We need people who can check, recheck, debug, test, and think. AI can assist, but human judgment and technical skill are required.



Portfolio and proof of work



A GitHub profile, portfolio, live websites, app links, screenshots, code samples, or past project examples are highly encouraged.



But be honest. Tell us what you personally built, what you helped with, what was built by a team, and whether AI assisted you.



If AI assisted you, that is not automatically bad. What matters is honesty.



Do not waste time submitting fake portfolio work, AI generated demos, copied templates, or projects you did not truly build. If you only edited part of a project, say that. If you were part of a team, say what part you personally handled.



Portfolios will be reviewed closely before interviews. We may check originality, code structure, UI quality, console behavior, technical patterns, design quality, and whether your skill claims match the submitted work.



If you do not have a strong portfolio, that is okay. You can still apply. We will use custom testing to measure your real skill level.



Testing process



Every shortlisted applicant may be given a custom test.



The test will be based on what you claim in your application. If you claim WordPress skills, we test WordPress. If you claim React/Next.js skills, we test that. If you claim backend/API skills, we test backend/API skills. If you claim senior level architecture skills, the test will be much more advanced.



Tests may take:



15 to 30 minutes for basic roles

30 to 60 minutes for junior/mid roles

Several hours for senior roles

Potentially longer for executive track technology roles



Be honest in your application. The test is designed to confirm your actual level so we can offer a fair compensation package and avoid wasting anyone’s time.



Interview process



We move fast.



If your application looks strong, you may hear back the same day. Sometimes you may hear back within an hour. Depending on volume, it may take 1 to 2 days.



The interview will usually be short, around 10 to 15 minutes by phone, Zoom, or Google Meet. We do not believe in wasting time with many long interviews.



If you pass the screening, test, and interview, we may give you a final test or trial task, then present a compensation offer.



If you accept, you will sign the required agreements, receive your assigned access/corporate
 if needed, and start quickly.



Schedule



We are flexible.



You can apply if you want:



Part time

Full time

Flexible hours

Weekend only work

A few hours per week

40 to 50+ hours per week

Project based work

A senior dedicated role



If you only have 5 to 10 hours per week but you have a skill we need, apply.



If you want a serious full time role and can dedicate yourself to our projects, apply.



For senior lead and executive track roles, we prefer people who can be highly dedicated and not spread across many other client projects.



For entry, junior, mid level, or specialist roles, we can be flexible if you are honest about your availability.



Time tracking



OnlineJobs.ph TimeProof is required while working. Other third party time tracking or work verification tools may also be used later depending on the role.



Payment and contractor setup



You will initially be hired as an independent contractor for a U.S. based company.



Payment schedule can be weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly depending on our agreement.



Payment options may include:



GCash

Maya



Direct bank transfer

Payoneer

Wise



You are responsible for your own taxes, BIR, benefits, and local obligations as an independent contractor.



Future company structure



This is currently remote work for a U.S. based company. However, there may be future opportunities connected to a Philippine BPO or technology company structure headquartered in BGC / Bonifacio Global City as the company expands.



Our company is based out of Northern California, with U.S. corporate and technology headquarters there. Joshua David spends a significant amount of time in Bonifacio Global City, Metro Manila, and travels between Northern California and the Philippines as needed.



Several members of our senior operations and executive team are Filipino and Tagalog speaking, so applicants should understand that this is not a company that is unfamiliar with the Philippines, Filipino workers, or Filipino culture.



NDA / confidentiality



If hired, you must sign a non-disclosure agreement before receiving internal project details, code access, system access, data, or proprietary plans.



Some roles may require additional confidentiality, IP assignment, non-compete, or contract terms depending on the position.



Who should apply



Apply if you are honest, skilled, reliable, and serious about building real technology.



Apply if you want to grow.



Apply if you are tired of boring work and want to be part of something bigger.



Apply if you have only one strong skill and can be honest about it.



Apply if you are senior level and want a serious opportunity to help build multiple technology platforms.



Apply if you want a company where strong performance can be rewarded quickly, not just once per year.



Do not apply if you exaggerate your skill level, disappear, copy/paste AI work blindly, submit fake work, or cannot communicate clearly.



About us



Dosh Technology Group, Inc. and affiliated companies are U.S. based technology and financial technology companies building business, personal finance, credit, data, automation, software, and intelligence platforms.



Joshua David is the Managing Director and co-founder. He is based out of Northern California, where the company’s U.S. corporate and technology headquarters are located, and spends a significant amount of time in BGC / Bonifacio Global City, Metro Manila. He has lived in the Philippines for over 20 years and travels between Northern California and the Philippines.



He will be directly involved in hiring, training, reviewing work, assigning projects, and approving pay.



We prefer applicants based in Metro Manila or Luzon when possible, but this is not required. Skill, honesty, reliability, communication, and execution matter most.



How to apply



Click the apply button on OnlineJobs.ph and follow the application steps.



Please start your application message with your number one strongest skill set or role category.



Examples:



WordPress

Front-End UI

Full-Stack Developer

Backend API Developer

Database Developer

Cloudflare Server Engineer

Mobile App Developer

AI Automation Developer

Senior Lead Developer

VP / CTO Track



Then answer these 3 questions clearly:



1. Which role or skill category best fits you?



Example: WordPress, front-end/UI, full-stack, backend/API/database, Cloudflare/server/security, mobile/PWA/APK, AI automation/data ingestion, senior lead developer, VP/CTO track, or other.



2. Briefly explain your real experience and strongest skills.



Please include the tools, languages, frameworks, platforms, or systems you have actually worked with. Be clear about what you personally know, what you have personally built, what you are still learning, and what you can realistically bring to the table.



3. Send any proof of work if available.



This can include GitHub, portfolio links, live websites/apps, screenshots, code samples, project examples, or anything else that helps us understand your real skill level. If you do not have a strong portfolio, that is okay. Just explain your experience honestly.



Important note about portfolios, resumes, GitHub, screenshots, and proof of work



Please do not waste your time or our time by submitting fake portfolio work, copied projects, AI generated demos, polished resumes that do not match your real skill level, or websites/apps/code that you did not actually build.



It is okay if AI assisted you. It is okay if you worked as part of a team. It is okay if you only built part of a project. What matters is that you are honest about what you personally did.



Our internal screening process may review your application, resume, GitHub, portfolio links, live websites, screenshots, code samples, UI structure, code structure, page behavior, console patterns, image layers, OCR readable text, similarity patterns, and other technical signals.



Applications and portfolios may be reviewed through Dosh Technology Systems proprietary logic screening, AI assisted analysis, plagiarism detection, code similarity review, portfolio authenticity checks, and multiple internal review models.



If you try to submit work that is not original, not yours, heavily copied, fully AI generated, or made to deceive potential employers, assume that it will be flagged during screening.



That may work with other employers, but please do not assume it will work with us.



Again, honesty and transparency are the best policy. If you do not have a portfolio, just say that. If you are new but willing to learn, say that. If you are strong in one area but weak in another, say that. We are hiring across many skill levels, and the goal is to match the right person to the right role and fair compensation package.



What happens after you apply



We are reviewing applicants quickly and may respond the same day, sometimes within an hour, depending on volume.



If your application looks like a possible fit, you may be sent a formal application link where you will answer more detailed questions about your experience, skills, availability, expected pay, portfolio, and preferred role.



Based on those answers, you may be invited to complete a first skills test. This test will be based on what you told us you can do. For example, if you say you know WordPress, you may receive a WordPress related test. If you say you know backend/API/database work, your test may be related to that. If you apply for a senior or executive track role, the test may be more advanced.



If you pass the first screening and test, you may be invited to a short phone, Zoom, or Google Meet interview with Joshua David or one of the founders. The interview is usually expected to be around 10 to 15 minutes. It is mainly to meet you, understand your background, put a face with the name, and see if there is a good fit.



If both sides want to continue after the interview, you may receive one final custom test based on the role and compensation level being considered.



If you pass the final step, you may receive a formal offer with your starting compensation package. If accepted, you will sign the required NDA/confidentiality agreement, receive any assigned company access or corporate
 needed, and may be able to start as soon as within 24 to 48 hours depending on your availability.



Please be honest in your application. We are hiring across many skill levels, from basic WordPress support all the way to senior technology leadership. It is better to clearly explain your real current skill level than to overstate your experience.



Final message from Joshua David



Hi fellow Pinoys,



Before you apply, I want to personally say thank you for taking the time to read this full job post.



Even though I am American, I have lived in the Philippines for over 20 years and spent most of my adult life connected to the country. Much of that time was in the Visayas / Cebu area. I am based out of Northern California, where our U.S. corporate and technology headquarters are located, but I spend a significant amount of time in Bonifacio Global City, Metro Manila, and travel between Northern California and the Philippines.



The Philippines is not just a place I visit. It is part of my life, my family, and my story. I have 5 Fil-Am children, so Filipino culture, Filipino family values, and the Filipino way of life are very personal to me.



If you make it to an interview with me, please do not be nervous. I promise I will not give you a nosebleed. Haha. The interview will not be some long, high-pressure corporate interrogation. It will usually be quick, respectful, and direct. I want to understand who you are, what you can do, and whether we can build something together.



I do not like how many companies waste applicants’ time with too many unnecessary steps, repeated interviews, and slow decision-making. If you are a good fit, we can move fast. You may hear back within a few hours, possibly be hired within 24 to 72 hours, and potentially start onboarding or working by next week.



If you are honest with me, work hard, communicate clearly, and give real effort, I will treat you like part of the team and business family, not like just a number on a payroll sheet.



Aabangan ko ang ating pag-uusap at ang posibilidad na ika’y maging parte ng aming pamilya. Maraming salamat sa oras mo.



Good luck, and I look forward to reading your application soon.

title: Media Buyer for Ecommerce | Toys and Games Niche
description:
About the Role



Seller Fuel (dba Toy Launch) is looking for an experienced Media Buyer to join our growing team.



You'll plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across ecommerce channels, driving profitable growth for our toy & game brand clients.



We live by FUN, UPBEAT, EFFICIENT, and LIMITLESS. You'll see that in how we work and how we treat every client's ad spend like it's our own.



This role is for someone who thrives on data, knows how to turn ad spend into revenue, and wants ownership over real campaigns from day one.



What You'll Do



- Plan, launch, and manage paid media campaigns across ecommerce advertising platforms (Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta, TikTok Ads, or similar)

- Conduct keyword and audience research to identify high-intent, profitable targeting opportunities

- Manage campaign budgets and bids to hit ACoS, TACoS, and ROAS targets

- Monitor campaign performance daily and make real-time adjustments to bids, targeting, and budgets

- Write and test ad copy and creative variations to improve click-through and conversion rates

- Apply negative keyword and audience exclusions to eliminate wasted spend

- Analyze performance data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations

- Build and maintain performance reports for internal and client review

- Stay current on platform updates and testing new features or ad formats

- Collaborate with account managers and clients to align media strategy with broader growth goals



What We're Looking For



- At least 2 years of hands-on media buying experience in ecommerce

- Proven track record managing paid campaigns and hitting performance targets (ACoS, TACoS, ROAS, or similar)

- Strong analytical skills. Comfortable reading performance data and adjusting strategy accordingly

- Experience with Amazon Advertising, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or TikTok Ads

- Detail-oriented with strong budget management discipline

- Clear written and verbal communication for client-facing reporting

- Nice to have: experience in an agency setting, familiarity with tools like like Helium 10, Perpetua, Skai, or similar PPC/media buying management platforms



!!! If you know how to turn ad spend into real revenue and want to do it for growing toy & game brands, we want to hear from you. !!!



Perks & Work Setup



- 100% remote work

- Career growth opportunities in a thriving eCommerce agency

- A culture where Fun, Upbeat, Efficient, and Limitless aren't buzzwords. They're how we work



About Seller Fuel & Toy Launch



Seller Fuel helps eCommerce entrepreneurs grow and scale while making a meaningful impact.



Our in-house brand, LakiKid, supports children with Autism, ADHD, and Sensory Processing Disorder. Our products appear in over 300 U.S. venues, from NBA arenas to classrooms, through partnerships with KultureCity's Sensory Inclusive Initiative.



How to Apply



Please follow these steps:



Step 1: Use exactly 7 Apply Points when submitting your application on OnlineJobs.ph.

Step 2: In your first reply (before we send the formal application form), include:



1. How many years of media buying experience do you have, and in which ecommerce niches or platforms?

2. Walk us through a campaign you managed. What was the goal, and what results did you achieve (ACoS, ROAS, or revenue growth)?

3. Which ad platforms are you most experienced with (Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.)?

4. Can you share a sample of your work, such as a campaign report, dashboard, or case study (with client names/data redacted if needed)?

5. Describe a time a campaign underperformed. What did you do to fix it?

6. Expected monthly salary (USD). This role requires availability during US hours. Are you available to work during this time? (Yes/No)

7. One fun fact about yourself



Step 3: Please submit a link to your CV / resume



!!! Only applicants who follow these instructions will receive the application form link. If you can't meet these steps, we won't provide the form. !!!



Ready to put your media buying skills to work for brands that actually matter? Apply now.

title: Influencer Research & Outreach Specialist — Jewellery Brand (Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Hello,



I'm David. I run a jewellery brand launching in the German-speaking market — Germany, Austria and Switzerland. Gold vermeil: sterling silver with a thick layer of real gold. Quiet, minimal, considered.



I need one person, full-time, long-term to own our influencer research and outreach.



We've done the preparation. You execute it.



You won't be guessing what a good creator looks like. We give you:



Our Ideal Creator Profile — exactly who we're looking for

The creator requirements — the criteria every account must meet before it goes on the list

The outreach templates, including the German versions

Clear KPIs so you always know whether you're on track



Your job is to apply all of that consistently, at volume, without cutting corners.



The work



Find creators — two ways only: 
 (paid database, I'll give you access) and organically on TikTok and Instagram — hashtag searches, the "suggested accounts" rabbit hole, and creators already tagged by similar jewellery brands.



Check every account against our requirements. Real comments or bot spam? Organic growth or a suspicious spike? Is her audience actually in Germany, Austria or Switzerland? Does her aesthetic match ours? The criteria are written down — you apply them honestly, including when an account you like doesn't pass.



Log everything accurately in our tracker: handle, working profile link, platform, follower count plus the date you checked, country, niche, contact route. Never invent or estimate a number. If you can't verify it, write "unknown" — a blank is a correct answer, a guess is not.



Send the outreach. Find her business
, her management, or DM her. Our messages are short, personal and direct — no long pitches. You work from our templates and add one line that proves you actually looked at her account: something specific she posted, not "I love your content". That one line is the difference between a reply and silence, and it's the part I'm hiring you for.



This is high volume. You'll send a lot of messages every day — but never the same message twice with only the name swapped. That's obvious to creators and it burns accounts we can't get back.



Then follow up on schedule, maximum three times, each one adding something new. Tell me about every reply the same day.



What you don't do: promise anything. You never tell a creator we'll send product, pay her, or work with her — I approve every partnership. And no claims beyond your brief: gold vermeil is not solid gold, and saying otherwise is a legal problem in Germany.



You



Minimum 40 hours a week, more is welcome. Philippine hours — I'm in the same timezone. Excellent written English. Fast and accurate, which is the hard combination and the real requirement here. Comfortable in Google Sheets. Honest when the numbers are disappointing — I'd rather hear it Friday than find out in a month.



You don't need to speak German. We provide the German templates, and using ChatGPT or any AI tool to check or adjust a sentence is completely fine — I use them myself. What AI can't do for you is d
 which creator fits us, or notice the specific thing in her feed worth mentioning. That still comes from you actually looking at the account.



Nice to have: outreach experience, familiarity with Modash or similar tools, any German at all, an interest in jewellery or design. Never done outreach before but careful and quick? Apply anyway — everything else I'll train.



The offer



USD 300 per month to start, fixed, paid on time.



I'm open to raising that — up to double — for someone who performs well, thinks along with me, and goes beyond what I asked for. That's not a vague promise: it's a genuine path, and I'd rather pay one excellent person well than replace a cheap one every six months. But it starts at 300 and it's earned from there.



Long-term role, direct contact with me, no agency in between.



How to apply



Start your message with the word: KAMILLE. Applications without it won't be read — it's the fastest way to find people who read carefully, which is half the job.



Then, briefly:



Your available hours per week and usual working times.

Links to two Instagram or TikTok creators who'd fit a quiet, minimal, German-market jewellery brand — one sentence each on why, something specific about her account.

How do you spot bought followers versus real engagement? Three or four sentences, your own words.

title: Full-Time Social Media Content Editor & Video Creator
description:
We’re looking for a fast, creative and highly motivated Social Media Content Editor / Video Creator to join our team full-time.



This role is for someone who understands how social media works and knows how to create videos that grab attention, keep people watching and make them want to come back for more.



We’ll mainly be creating content for YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, with the possibility of helping with other social media platforms and content as we grow.



What you’ll be doing



* Editing short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts

* Editing longer YouTube videos when needed

* Turning raw footage into engaging, entertaining content

* Adding captions, text, sound effects, music, zooms, cuts and other edits to keep viewers watching

* Helping us come up with ideas for videos, hooks and ways to improve our content

* Looking at what is performing well and helping us create more of it

* Repurposing content across different platforms

* Keeping up with social media trends and understanding what gets views

* Potentially helping with thumbnails, titles and other areas of content creation

* Working quickly — if something is performing well, we want to be able to create and post more content while the opportunity is there



The person we’re looking for



You need to:



* Speak and understand English very well

* Have excellent attention to detail

* Work quickly without sacrificing quality

* Understand what makes someone stop scrolling

* Understand the importance of the first 1–3 seconds of a video

* Be creative and willing to suggest ideas rather than simply waiting for instructions

* Be comfortable receiving feedback and making changes quickly

* Be reliable and available Monday to Friday

* Be able to work full-time

* Have a strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram and YouTube

* Have experience editing social media videos



Experience is a big advantage, but we care more about what you can actually produce than what your CV says.



If you don’t have years of experience but you can genuinely wow us with your editing, creativity and understanding of social media, we still want to hear from you.



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are not looking for someone who simply follows instructions and waits for the next task.



We want someone who can look at a video and say:



“This bit is going to lose viewers — I’d change it like this.”



We want someone who is interested in getting results, not just completing edits.



Because of the speed we work at, we also need someone who can respond and turn work around quickly during working hours.



Your application



To make sure we find the right person, please DO NOT send us a generic copy-and-paste application.



Your application must include:



1. Tell us in 3–5 sentences why you think you would be good at this job.



2. Send us links to 3 videos you have personally edited.

Please explain briefly what you did on each one.



3. Tell us which editing software you use and how long you have been using it.



4. Give us ONE example of a TikTok, Instagram Reel or YouTube Short you have seen recently that you think was particularly well made. Tell us WHY you think it worked.



5. QUICK TEST — this is important:

Imagine we give you a video that starts slowly and has a 30-second introduction before anything interesting happens.



In 2–3 sentences, tell us what you would do to improve it.



6. THE TRAP:

At the very beginning of your application, write the words:



“I read the whole job advert.”



Applications that don’t include this may be ignored.



We’re doing this because we want to see who actually reads instructions and who is simply sending the same application to every job.



Video Test



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to complete a small video editing test using footage we provide.



This will help us see your actual ability rather than relying on a CV.



We will be looking at:



* Editing quality

* Creativity

* Pacing

* Hooks

* Captions/text

* Understanding of social media

* Attention to detail

* How well you follow instructions

* How quickly you complete the task



Please don’t spend hours on the test. We want to see how you think and edit, not how much unpaid work you’re willing to do.



This job could be a great fit if…



You’re the type of person who watches a video and automatically starts thinking:



“I would cut that bit.”

“That needs a better hook.”

“That should happen sooner.”

“That could be turned into three Shorts.”

“People are going to comment on that.”



If that sounds like you, we want to hear from you.



Full-time | Monday–Friday | Social Media / Video Editing | YouTube | TikTok | Instagram



Please apply with your examples and answers to the questions above.

We're looking for a creative, resourceful Canva designer to join our growing team and help create the monthly social media content inside our real estate marketing membership.



We'll provide the brand, direction, examples, and resources. We're looking for someone who can take that direction, find inspiration, source the assets they need, and confidently bring ideas to life with minimal supervision.



If you love beautiful design, enjoy studying social media trends, and take pride in producing polished work, we'd love to meet you.

_______________________________________________

We create marketing resources used by thousands of real estate agents across the United States. Over the past several years, we've helped 70,000+ customers and earned 5,000+ five-star reviews.



We're now building the next chapter of our company and are looking for a few exceptional people who want to grow with us long-term. We're building a small, high-performing creative team where the right people can earn more responsibility, more hours, and higher pay as the company continues to grow.

* Organizing and exporting completed files

* Finds strong inspiration without copying it

* Can take an idea and turn it into a polished finished design

* Works independently without constant check-ins

* Keeps projects organized

* Meets deadlines consistently

* Communicates clearly when they need help

* Takes ownership of their work

_______________________________________________

* Good judgment

* Creativity

* Ownership

* Resourcefulness

* Reliability

* Attention to detail

* A willingness to keep learning and improving

We do expect curiosity, initiative, resourcefulness, and someone who takes pride in producing exceptional work.

_______________________________________________

* Ability to research design inspiration and current social media trends

* Comfortable using AI tools to help source images and creative assets

* Strong written English communication

* Reliable internet connection and computer

* Highly organized and dependable



Bonus Points

* Experience creating Instagram carousel posts

* Experience creating short-form social media content

* Familiarity with AI image generation tools

* Basic video editing experience

* Experience creating marketing content

_______________________________________________



Hours & Pay

* Approximately 10 hours per week to start

* $5 USD/hour

* Flexible schedule (within reasonable working hours)

* Long-term opportunity with room for increased hours and responsibility as the company grows



We care much more about consistently producing excellent work than looking busy for a certain number of hours.

_______________________________________________

The Creative Assessment is the most important part of our hiring process.

title: Fleet Maintenance Coordinator & Technical Specialist (Toyota Hybrids / Remote Dispatch & Diagnostics)
description:
Type: Full-Time | Remote (US EST Hours)



About the Role

We are a fast-paced, multi-state logistics and fleet management organization seeking a methodical, highly detailed, and mechanically inclined Fleet Maintenance Coordinator.



Our operational fleet relies heavily on Toyota Corolla Hybrids. In this role, you will act as the technical "brain" supporting our physical staff mechanic. The mechanic is on the ground physically touching the vehicles—you are not. Your primary mission is to direct where the mechanic goes, research complex diagnostic trouble codes (P-Codes), source parts, negotiate local shop quotes, and strictly verify that every assigned job is 100% completed before a vehicle returns to service.



This position calls for a systems-driven, rule-following, and detail-obsessed technical coordinator who takes pride in data accuracy and thrives in structured, process-oriented workflows.



Who You Are (Ideal Personality Profile)

Obsessively Detail-Oriented: You naturally double-check part numbers, track service intervals down to the exact mile, and keep fleet software 100% accurate and updated in real time.



Process & Rule-Driven: You believe in following standard operating procedures (SOPs) to the letter and hold others accountable to ensure zero steps are skipped.



Methodical & Calm Under Pressure: You don't get flustered by daily operational updates; you systematically prioritize tasks based on safety, urgency, and cost.



Firm & Task-Focused: You are comfortable asserting authority to follow up with mechanics, suppliers, and tea
mbers to ensure open maintenance tickets are fully resolved and signed off.



Key Responsibilities

Mechanic Dispatch & Schedule Control: Build and manage daily/weekly task schedules for our on-staff mechanic, directing exact vehicle locations and maintenance priorities.



Remote Troubleshooting & Diagnostic Research: Serve as the mechanic’s remote technical advisor. Research OBD-II scanner codes (P-Codes), repair guides, and technical service bulletins (TSBs) to assist the mechanic in resolving issues (from headlight and sensor replacements to hybrid system maintenance).



Job Quality & Completion Verification: Track every open maintenance ticket end-to-end. Verify that the mechanic has fully addressed the core issue, uploaded photos/logs, and marked the job 100% complete.



Parts Procurement & Shop Quotes: Source, negotiate, and order OEM/aftermarket replacement parts. Call local repair shops, tire centers, and dealerships to get competitive quotes for warranty work, recalls, or specialized repairs.



Software Precision & Real-Time Logging: Maintain meticulous records of parts invoices, labor hours, maintenance logs, and vehicle status updates in our fleet management software.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Mechanical Expertise: Strong practical understanding of vehicle mechanics, electrical sensors, engine systems, and OBD-II scanner trouble codes (P-Codes).



Toyota Hybrid Specialization: Direct familiarity with Toyota Corolla Hybrid powertrains, sensor setups, and routine service requirements.



High Technical Precision: Meticulous approach to data entry, record-keeping, and process documentation.



Assertive Follow-Through: Driven to follow up relentlessly until tasks are verified as completed.



C2 Spoken & Written English: Excellent, clear, and assertive communication skills for frequent telephone calls with vendors, parts suppliers, and dealership service desks.



How to Apply (Strict Screening Process)

To be considered for this position, you MUST complete our mandatory screening process:



???? Step 1: Complete the mandatory technical & logic assessment here:

Resume / Work History: Detailing your background in vehicle mechanics, fleet maintenance, parts procurement, or remote logistics support.



Technical Example: Briefly describe a time you researched a complex mechanical issue or P-code (preferably on a Toyota or hybrid vehicle) and managed the resolution remotely.



Video Introduction: A link to a short (1–2 minute) video introducing yourself, stating your mechanical background, and explaining how you ensure other tea
mbers complete their assigned steps in a process.

title: AI Video Generation Specialist — Photorealistic Real-World Scenes
Sales Rep – US Local Business Cold Calling | 3 Days/Week
description:
Company: Networking Neighbors (US-based) Type: Part-time | Remote | 3 days/week (Tuesday–Thursday) Pay: $6.00 USD/hr + performance bonus Hours: 8 hours/day | 24 hours/week Start: Immediately 



This job is for closers only. 



We are a US-based local advertising company that sells ad space on large-format 9x12 glossy direct mail postcards delivered to 10,000 households via the United States Post Office. Local businesses pay $650 per ad slot to put their offer directly into the mailboxes of their neighbors. No algorithms, no spam filters, just guaranteed reach. 



We are looking for a confident, high-energy sales rep to make outbound calls to US local businesses Tuesday through Thursday and close deals over the phone. You will not be gathering leads or sending
s. A dedicated tea
mber handles all lead research and
 warm-up before you call. You show up Tuesday morning with a loaded call list, and you dial. 



The target is 5 closed sales per week. That is less than 2 per day. If you are a real closer calling 8 hours a day with warm leads in front of you, that is very achievable. 



What You'll Be Selling 



A 9x12 full-color glossy postcard mailed to every household in a target zone through the United States Post Office. Businesses share the card; each gets their own ad spot. 



Distribution: 10,000 households per mailing 



Price: $650 per ad slot 



Target clients: real estate agents, dentists, home service companies, gyms, salons, auto repair shops, insurance agents, tax preparers, mortgage brokers, veterinarians 



This is a proven product. Physical direct mail works. Your job is to get decision-makers on the phone and close them. 





What You'll Do 



Work Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday - 8 hours per day 



Call through a pre-built lead list loaded in Go High Level (GHL) 



Many leads have already received a warm-up
 



Overcome objections and close sales over the phone 



Log all call outcomes in GHL after each call 



Attend a short weekly check-in with the owner 



All call scripts, objection handling guides, and training materials are provided. You will not be starting from zero. 



 



What You Won't Do 



No lead research 



No
 writing or sending 



No admin tasks outside of logging calls in GHL and sending invoices once you close a sale 



Your only job is to call and close. 



 



Performance Bonus 



Once you close enough sales to fill your first postcard (all 20 ad slots sold and paid), you will receive a performance bonus. Details discussed at time of hire. 



This is in addition to your hourly pay and is our way of rewarding reps who hit full-card milestones. 





Requirements 



Proven experience cold calling US businesses this is non-negotiable. Tell us specifically what you sold, to whom, and what your close rate was. 



Excellent spoken English - you are calling American business owners 



Reliable internet and a quiet working environment for calls 



Available Tuesday–Thursday during US business hours (Pacific or Mountain time zone preferred) 



Experience with Go High Level (GHL) is a strong plus 



Organized and self-accountable - you log every call, every outcome 



 



Probationary Period 



This role begins with a 2-week paid trial. 



Week 1: Training, product review, and first calls. You must log all daily activity in GHL. 



Weeks 2: Minimum 2 closed sales expected across week. Reps who hit this continue. Reps who do not will not move past the trial. 



The product works. The scripts are provided. The leads are pre-built. We expect closers to close. 



 



To Apply 



Do not send a generic application. We will not respond to copy-paste cover letters. 



Please answer all five questions in your application: 



1. What B2B product or service have you sold by cold calling US businesses? What was your average close rate? 



2. Do you have experience selling to local business owners (not corporate)? Give a specific example. 



3. How many outbound calls are you able to make in an 8-hour day? 



4. Do you have experience using Go High Level (GHL)? If yes, describe how you used it. 



5. Have you seen Spiderman Brand New Day? If not, do you plan to? If so, did you like it? 



Applications that do not answer all five questions will not be reviewed. 





Networking Neighbors is a US-based local advertising company helping small businesses reach thousands of households in their neighborhood through direct mail campaigns.

title: Day Shift Project Coordinator (No Nights, Weekends Off) — Bilingual English/Spanish
description:
This is a normal day job. 9am to 6pm Manila time, Monday to Friday. You sleep at night.



We are a US company that manages field crews working after-hours at commercial sites across the United States and Canada. The crews work overnight — but you do not. Because Manila is 12 hours ahead of New York, our night is your day. You cover our busiest hours on a comfortable daytime shift.



Most jobs supporting US companies force you onto a graveyard shift. This one does the opposite. Your Monday morning is our Sunday night. You keep your weekends, your family time and your sleep.



Your day, in Manila time



9:00am — call each crew as they arrive and confirm they have what they need

10:00am to 4:00pm — take calls, solve access problems, collect job photos, update records

4:00pm to 6:00pm — crews wrap up, you check everything is filed and send the handover

6:00pm — done. Your evening is yours



Language — please read before applying

This is a phone job. You will be on calls every shift with crew leads and site contacts. Many of our crew leads speak Spanish first.



Fluent spoken English, clear on a phone call

Fluent spoken Spanish. Several crew leads will work with you entirely in Spanish

Written English good enough for short, clear reports

We will do a live voice interview in both languages



What you will do



Confirm crews are on site at the start of every shift

Call site contacts or security when a crew cannot get access

Collect job photos and file them against the right location

Chase crews who have not reported in

Update job status in our project software as each site is completed

Send one written handover at the end of your day



The pace

Multiple crews working same night. You are the one person who knows where everything stands.



What we need



Confident on the phone in both languages

Organized. You will live in a spreadsheet and a job tracking system

Persistent and polite. If a crew has not reported, you keep after them

No industry experience needed. We will teach you the work



The offer

100,000 php per month

40 hours, Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Manila time

Weekends off, always

Long-term role with steady work ahead



To apply, send a 60-second voice recording in English and a 60-second recording in Spanish, introducing yourself and describing a time you had to chase someone for information. Applications without a voice sample will not be reviewed.

title: Appointment Setter (Sales)
description:
Sales Appointment Setter | Full-Time



Salary: $1,000/month + performance bonuses

Hours: 40 hours per week

Working Hours: 9am – 6pm UK time

Join a fast-growing international education company where you’ll be responsible for engaging with leads, booking sales calls, and earning performance-based bonuses in a supportive, high-energy team environment.



This role is responsible for creating sales opportunities by engaging with leads and booking qualified calls for our Sales Executives.



You will be communicating with leads across WhatsApp,
, phone calls, and other channels.



Your role is to guide conversations, follow up consistently, and ensure that interested leads are converted into booked calls.



This is a performance-driven role. You will be expected to manage a high volume of conversations and consistently hit booking targets.

Swoosh English is an online English exam academy founded in 2013. We provide online courses and lessons to students conducted by a team of fully qualified and experienced English teachers to help them pass their IELTS/OET/PTE exams.



We have 550+ reviews with a 4.8 rating on Trustpilot:

We are looking for someone who is:



Friendly, approachable, and easy to talk to

A strong communicator with high energy

Persistent without being aggressive

Goal-oriented and driven to hit targets

Organised and able to manage multiple conversations at once

Strategic in how they approach conversations and follow-up



Key Responsibilities



Engage with leads via WhatsApp, phone,
, and other platforms

Respond quickly and professionally to inbound enquiries

Follow up with leads who have not yet booked

Guide conversations toward booking a call

Manage and track leads using CRM systems

Maintain high levels of activity and responsiveness

Attend tea
etings and training sessions



Requirements



Minimum 2 years experience in sales or appointment setting

Strong English communication skills (written and spoken)

Confident and comfortable speaking on the phone

Experience using CRM systems and communication tools

Ability to manage a high volume of conversations

Strong organisational skills

Reliable internet and working setup



How to Apply:



Please submit the following:

2. A personlised cover letter explaining why you are suitable for the Sales Appointment Setter position.

* Why you believe you would perform well in this role.

Applications that do not include all the requested materials may not be considered.



Why Join Us



Performance bonuses and incentives

Ongoing training and development

Remote work environment

Opportunity to grow within a high-performing and ambitious sales team

title: Long-Form YouTube Video Editor & Motion Graphics Designer (Documentary Explainers)
description:
IMPORTANT: Begin your application with the words STORY BEFORE EFFECTS.



We are building a high-quality, faceless YouTube channel for small-business owners. Our videos explain real business and cybersecurity problems through calm documentary storytelling, realistic footage and clear UI motion.



We need one person who can handle both long-form video editing and motion design.



WEEKLY PACKAGE



Each completed weekly package contains:



One polished 6–7 minute YouTube video.



Four straightforward vertical Shorts of approximately 30 seconds each.



Complete editable project files and an organised asset folder.



The complete package must be delivered within three working days and should require no more than approximately 20 hours. How you organise that work during the three days is up to you.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



You will receive:



A locked script and final voiceover.



A timestamped audiovisual script showing what should happen visually.



Photorealistic real-world AI footage created by a separate specialist.



Layered Figma UI, screen and document assets.



Approved evidence, factual boundaries and packaging direction.



Clear consolidated feedback during the revision stage.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Edit the complete long-form video with calm, deliberate pacing.



Animate layered UI, invoices,
 threads, payment records, login screens and simple diagrams.



Composite screens and documents into real-world footage where required.



Make physical action and camera movement work naturally with the voiceover.



Use restrained movement, focus, negative space and held frames instead of unnecessary effects.



Add subtle Foley, room tone, device sounds and appropriate ambience. Music will be handled separately.



Produce four clean vertical Shorts from the long-form video.



Deliver organised and relinkable editable project files.



THIS IS NOT THE RIGHT ROLE IF YOU ONLY PRODUCE



CapCut templates.



Gaming montages.



Talking-head jump cuts.



Fast-cut social-media reels.



Flashy transition showreels.



Generic hacker or cybersecurity footage.



Corporate training videos where every sentence receives an animation.



Motion should guide the viewer’s attention and improve understanding. It should not decorate every word.



PAYMENT



The fixed payment is US$170 for each completed and accepted weekly package.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer every question:



Send three links to videos you personally edited. At least one must be a documentary, explainer or educational video lasting four minutes or longer.



Send one example of layered UI, screen or document animation. State whether you worked from Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop or another source.



Clearly explain what work you personally completed in each example.



Which software do you use for editing, motion design, compositing and project handoff?



Briefly explain how you d
 when to cut, hold the frame or move the camera while working from a voiceover.



Confirm that you can complete one 6–7 minute video and four Shorts within three working days and approximately 20 hours.



Confirm that you will provide the complete editable project, linked assets and commercially usable final exports.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive the same paid 45–60 second contractor test.



Test payment: US$25.



Supplied footage, voiceover, Figma assets and audiovisual instructions.



One correction pass.



Final export and complete editable project required.



This is intended to become reliable weekly work for the right person.



Finish your application with the words CALM MOTION.

title: Senior Content Writer
description:
Catsy is a B2B SaaS platform (
) for product information management (PIM) and digital asset management (DAM), built for industrial manufacturers, wholesale distributors, and B2B brands. We keep product content accurate, enriched, and syndicated across every channel a business sells through.



The role



The Content Marketing Writer owns our written content across the full marketing surface — website pages, blog articles and SEO content, brochures and sell sheets, ebooks and guides. This person writes independently, at volume, moving fluidly between a snappy product page and a sixty-page guide while holding our established house voice on every piece. The work has to be technically credible to an industrial B2B audience and disciplined enough to move buyers through a considered, multi-stakeholder sales cycle.



What you'll do

* Write and maintain website copy — product pages, landing pages, feature descriptions — that is clear, on-brand, and built to convert.

* Produce blog and SEO content — pillar pages, comparison articles, category explainers — that ranks in search and reads like it came from a genuine practitioner.

* Create sales and marketing collateral — brochures, sell sheets, spec sheets, one-pagers — in our brand style, translating product capabilities into buyer-facing value.

* Author long-form assets — ebooks, definitive guides, and downloadable resources that serve as gated lead magnets and establish our authority.

* Tailor messaging across three core audiences — Shopify merchants, industrial distributors, and Adobe Commerce / Magento merchants — each with distinct pains and vocabulary.

* Hold the house voice with precision: third-person observed-reality perspective, no second-person "you/your," no "it's not X, it's Y" constructions, problem-agitate-solution structure.

* Partner with product marketing to turn positioning and launches into published content on a predictable cadence.

* Maintain an editorial calendar and ship consistently rather than in bursts.



What you bring

* 3+ years writing B2B content, ideally for SaaS, technical, or industrial audiences.

* A portfolio showing range across formats — website copy, SEO articles, and at least one long-form asset (ebook, guide, or brochure suite).

* Fluency (or demonstrated fast-ramp ability) in technical and industrial subject matter; you're not intimidated by product data, distribution, or supply-chain concepts.

* Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals: search intent, keyword structure, on-page optimization, and how content earns rankings.

* The discipline to write inside a defined style guide without drifting, and to take editorial feedback without ego.

* Self-direction — handed a topic and a brief, you return a finished, on-voice draft.



Nice to have

Experience marketing PIM, DAM, e-commerce, ERP, or adjacent B2B software.

Familiarity with industrial distribution, manufacturing, or wholesale.

Comfort writing about AI and emerging technical concepts (MCP, agentic workflows) for a business audience.

Basic facility with a CMS and light HTML.

What success looks like



In the first 90 days, this person is independently shipping publish-ready content across formats — website, blog, and collateral — holds the house voice without heavy editing, has a first ebook or guide underway, and has taken the content engine off the founder's desk.

title: # Content Research VA — YouTube / Instagram / TikTok
description:
We are looking for a reliable Content Research VA in the Philippines to help us build a short-form content research system in the international tax and relocation niche.



**This is a time-sensitive role and we are looking to start immediately. If you see this job post, please tell us whether you are available to complete the paid test today, or the earliest time you can start.**



This is **not a scriptwriting role** and you do not need to be a tax expert.



Your main job will be to find strong videos from a list of approved creators and organise the source material for our AI system.



## What you will do



* Research approved YouTube, Instagram and TikTok accounts

* Find relevant, high-quality videos

* Collect the video URL

* Record the title/topic

* Record date posted and views

* Extract or generate the full transcript

* Put videos into organised source batches

* Check that we have not already used the same URL

* Follow a simple content relevance checklist

* Keep our source database organised



Topics will include:



* Moving from the UK/Ireland/Europe

* Cyprus tax and relocation

* Dubai/UAE relocation

* International tax residency

* Non-dom regimes

* Exit taxes

* Wealth taxes

* Capital gains tax

* Dividend tax

* Business owners relocating

* Holding companies and business structuring

* Selling a business before/after relocating

* European tax changes

* Residency and immigration changes



## What we are looking for



* Excellent attention to detail

* Good written English

* Comfortable researching YouTube/social media

* Comfortable using ChatGPT/AI tools

* Able to follow SOPs exactly

* Reliable and organised

* Able to identify interesting content rather than simply collecting random videos

* Familiarity with Notion/Google Sheets is helpful



Tax knowledge is useful but **not required**.



## Paid Trial



The first task will be a paid trial and we would like to begin as soon as possible.



We will give you:



* One approved creator

* Our topic criteria

* A simple research template



You will find and organise approximately 8 strong source videos from that creator.



If the work is accurate and the sources are good, this can become an ongoing role with regular weekly work.



When applying, please answer:



1. Have you previously done YouTube, TikTok or Instagram research?

2. What AI tools do you currently use?

3. Are you comfortable extracting video transcripts?

4. Please send one example of a research/VA project you have worked on.

5. Are you available to complete the paid trial **today**? If not, what is the earliest time you can start?

6. Start your application with the word **CYPRUS** so we know you read the full post.

title: BPO Sales Growth Partner – AU/NZ
description:
BPO Sales Growth Partner – AU/NZ



Paid Hourly + Performance Bonuses



Arkero connects Australian and New Zealand businesses with skilled Philippines-based remote professionals through our technology-led staffing platform.



We’re looking for experienced BPO sales, business development and client-facing professionals who understand how to speak with Australian and New Zealand business owners, build trust and convert opportunities into clients.



You’ll receive stable hourly pay, with additional performance bonuses for exceeding agreed KPIs and sales targets.



Why Arkero is different



Traditional staffing and outsourcing can take weeks to source, shortlist and place someone.



Arkero is building a faster, technology-led model designed around simplicity, speed and better matching.



Our platform is being built around AI-driven talent matching and scoring, a pre-qualified Philippines talent pool, fast client onboarding, simple contracting and payments, easy replacement and additional worker requests, and a long-term goal of moving from staffing request to accepted candidate in minutes, not weeks.



We are people-first, but technology is what allows us to remove much of the slow, manual process that still exists across traditional staffing and outsourcing.



You won’t simply be selling another BPO service. You’ll be introducing businesses to a new way of finding and managing remote talent.



The role



Your focus will be on building relationships with Australian and New Zealand businesses and turning those relationships into new Arkero clients.



This will include prospecting, starting conversations with business owners and decision-makers, understanding staffing needs, explaining the Arkero model, following up with prospects, managing opportunities through the sales process and closing new clients.



You’ll work to clear, agreed KPIs and targets.



Strong performers who exceed those targets will receive additional bonuses on top of their hourly pay.



We want people who are motivated by results, and we want those results to be properly rewarded.



You could be a strong fit if you have experience in BPO, outsourcing, remote staffing or a related industry, genuine sales or business development experience, and have worked directly with Australian or New Zealand clients.



You should be confident speaking with business owners and senior decision-makers, able to build rapport quickly, comfortable prospecting and following up, organised with your pipeline, and have excellent written and spoken English.



Previous account management experience is valuable, but we are particularly interested in people who have personally generated and closed new business.



What we offer



Stable hourly pay.



Performance bonuses for exceeding agreed KPIs and targets.



Remote work.



The opportunity to work directly with Australian and New Zealand businesses.



Clear performance expectations.



Significant opportunity to grow as Arkero expands.



The chance to join a technology-led staffing business at an early stage.



To apply, please answer these 3 questions:



1. What was your previous BPO, outsourcing or sales role? Did you personally generate and close new business, or primarily manage existing accounts?



2. Have you worked directly with Australian or New Zealand business owners or decision-makers? Please briefly explain your experience.



3. What would you consider a realistic number of new clients for you to bring onboard each month once fully trained?

title: VIdeo Editor / AI Video Creator
description:
Video Editor / AI Video Creator



We are looking for a highly creative Video Editor / AI Video Creator to join our performance marketing team.



This is not a traditional video editing position.



We are looking for someone who understands how to combine strong editing skills with the newest AI video-generation tools to create engaging, high-performing advertising creatives for platforms such as **Meta, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube**.



The right person should be able to take a script or creative concept and turn it into a complete advertisement — including AI-generated scenes, avatars, UGC-style footage, B-roll, visual hooks, captions, sound design, and fast-paced editing.



## What You’ll Be Doing



* Create high-quality short-form and long-form video advertisements.

* Turn scripts and creative briefs into complete video concepts.

* Generate realistic AI actors, avatars, environments, scenes, and B-roll.

* Create authentic-looking **UGC-style advertisements** using both AI and traditional editing.

* Find creative ways to visually represent every important part of a script.

* Create strong visual hooks within the first few seconds of an advertisement.

* Edit videos specifically for **direct-response/performance marketing**.

* Use B-roll strategically to support the script rather than adding random stock footage.

* Create different versions of winning ads by changing hooks, scenes, characters, pacing, backgrounds, and visual concepts.

* Work with different personas, ages, genders, accents, and environments depending on the target audience.

* Produce videos that feel natural and continuous without noticeable AI glitches, awkward cuts, or inconsistent characters.

* Add captions, motion graphics, music, sound effects, transitions, and other elements that improve engagement.

* Continuously research new AI tools, editing techniques, viral formats, and creative trends.

* Analyze successful competitor ads and develop new concepts inspired by what is currently working.

* Work closely with our media buying and creative teams to produce new advertising concepts at a high volume.



## AI Tools & Skills



You should be comfortable experimenting with modern AI creative tools and workflows.



Experience with tools such as the following is a major advantage:



* Arcade

* OpenArt Director

* VEO

* Highfields 

* Runway

* Flux 3

* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* Midjourney

* ChatGPT / Claude

* AI image-to-video tools

* AI lip-sync and avatar tools

* AI voice-generation tools

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* After Effects

* CapCut

* Photoshop



You do **not** need to know every tool listed above.



What matters most is that you are extremely comfortable learning new AI tools and figuring out how to use them creatively.



## What We Are Looking For



* Strong video editing experience.

* Excellent creative judgment.

* Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention.

* Ability to create videos that do not look like generic templates.

* Strong attention to detail.

* Ability to notice unnatural AI movements, bad lip-sync, continuity problems, awkward transitions, or unrealistic scenes.

* Understanding of what makes social-media advertising engaging.

* Ability to match visuals and B-roll closely to what is being said in the script.

* Ability to create emotionally engaging and visually interesting scenes.

* Comfortable working independently and solving creative problems.

* Fast learner who actively experiments with new AI technology.

* Ability to produce a consistent volume of high-quality creatives.



## Very Important



We are not looking for someone whose job is simply to receive footage and edit it together.



We want a creator.



If a script says:



“AI handles most of the work for me,”



we expect you to think about how to visually communicate advanced AI, automation, technology, or futuristic workflows — not simply insert unrelated stock footage.



If a character or environment feels boring, you should have the creativity to improve it.



We want someone who constantly asks:



“How can I make this scene more interesting, believable, and engaging?”



## Performance Marketing Experience



Previous experience creating advertisements for:



* Meta /

* Instagram

* TikTok

* YouTube

* Lead generation

* Direct response

* Affiliate marketing



is a significant advantage.



Candidates who understand concepts such as hooks, retention, CTR, CPA, CPL, creative fatigue, winning angles, and creative testing will be strongly preferred.



## Who Will Succeed in This Role



You will probably love this position if you constantly experiment with new AI tools, follow AI-video developments, save interesting ads you see online, and enjoy figuring out how something was created.



We want someone who combines the mindset of a:



Video Editor + AI Creator + Creative Strategist.



Someone who doesn't just execute instructions but contributes ideas and brings their own creative signature to the videos they produce.



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your portfolio.

2. Examples of advertisements you personally created.

3. Examples of AI-generated videos or scenes you created.

4. A list of the AI video tools you currently use.

5. Your previous experience creating Meta/TikTok performance ads.

6. Your expected monthly salary.

7. Your availability.



**Please do not apply if your experience is limited to basic video editing.**



We are specifically looking for someone who is passionate about **AI video creation, advertising, and creative experimentation** and wants to become part of a team producing advertising creatives at scale.
